# End a Social Round Early — Implementation Plan (v2)

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Let the scorer of a social round end it after any number of complete holes, with a proper result (leader wins, level = halved), no handicap impact, correct side-game settlement and stats, working offline. Make "only full scorecards count towards the social handicap index" true everywhere, including existing data and old app versions.

**Architecture:**
- A new `rounds.holes_played` column records how many holes were played. NULL means the round was played as planned.
- The scoring store keeps the **planned** holes, so daily-handicap maths is unchanged, and gains a `holesPlayed` count. Anything that renders, validates or counts holes remaining slices to the played holes via `filterPlayableHoles`.
- **Ending is final.**
  - **Online:** a `SECURITY DEFINER` RPC `end_round_early` sets the column and trims side-game rows straight away.
  - **Offline:** a queued `round` sync item with action `'end_early'` does the same.
  - **Locally:** the end is stamped onto the SQLite scorecard rows, so it survives a relaunch.
- **Handicap.** A card-level `isCompleteForHandicap` gate keeps partial cards out of handicap on the client. A database trigger enforces the same rule on the server, which also covers old app versions. A one-off data fix removes existing partial cards from the index.
- **Part A** (Tasks A1a–A7) is a set of standalone fixes the feature builds on:
  - "N UP" margins, and 9-hole match completion;
  - the full-scorecards-only handicap rule, client and server;
  - skins priced on holes played;
  - offline-submitted rounds finalising, with the sync service running app-wide.

  It can merge on its own.
- **Part B** (Tasks B1a–B11) is the feature.

**Tech Stack:** Expo SDK 54 / React Native / TypeScript, Zustand, React Query, Expo SQLite (offline DAOs), Supabase (Postgres + RLS + RPC + triggers), Jest (`jest-expo`), pnpm.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-end-round-early-design.md`. Read the whole thing. **Revision 3 (R12–R21) overrides everything before it, and Revision 2 (R1–R11) overrides the original sections.**

## Global Constraints

- **Scope:** social (standalone) rounds only (`rounds.competition_id IS NULL`). Competition rounds behave exactly as today, apart from Part A's deliberate fixes.
- **Who can end.** "End round early" shows only when **all** of these hold:
  - the round is standalone;
  - the round is `in-progress`;
  - it isn't already ended (the store's `holesPlayed` is null);
  - scoring pairs are off;
  - the device scores **every** player: the store's `allowedPlayerIds` is empty **or** contains every `currentPlayers` id (`ScorecardEntryScreen` always fills it);
  - at least 1 hole is complete for every player;
  - not every planned hole is complete.
- **N** = the number of leading holes, in hole order from the round's first hole, on which every player has `strokes > 0`. A pickup (`strokes === PICKUP_SCORE`, 10) counts as scored. Scores on later holes are removed.
- **No Resume. No 9-of-18 conversion** (R12). An 18-hole round ended after 9 sets `holes_played = 9`, like any other N.
- **Handicap: only full scorecards count** (R21). The rules:
  - A card counts only if every planned hole for the round's `nine_type` has a score. A card from a round with `holes_played` set never counts.
  - A card with **no per-hole data at all** (legacy imports; multi-ball, whose server `scores` is `{}`) keeps today's gross-based behaviour, **unless** its round has `holes_played` set.
  - The rule is enforced on the client (`isCompleteForHandicap` and the `holes_played` belts) **and** on the server (triggers).
- **Match result:**
  - No holes remaining ⇒ "N UP" (`calculateMatchStatus` casing `'N up'`) or All Square / "A/S", never "N & 0" (I10, all matches).
  - Ended early: a real close-out against the **planned** holes stands. Otherwise the final lead after N wins.
- **Net:** an ended-early card's `total_net` = Σ(gross − strokes received) over the holes played. `daily_handicap_used` stays the planned round's daily handicap. Complete cards are unchanged.
- **Skins:**
  - Hole values are priced on the planned hole count.
  - Settlement buy-in = `calculateTotalPot(type, value, planned) × holesPlayed / planned / participants`.
  - Individual skins are zero-sum to within cent rounding.
  - Completed games are displayed from stored `skins_payouts`.
- **Wolf:** decisions after N are trimmed by the RPC, and the display reads "of N holes". Do **not** wire Wolf finalisation.
- **Not in this plan:** the nine-aware live daily handicap (old A2b–A2d) is a separate branch. Don't add `nineType` to `calculatePlayerStats`, `calculatePlayerTotals` or `calculatePlayingHandicap` here.
- **Copy** (exact strings):
  - "End round early": the sheet title and the ⋮ button's `accessibilityLabel`.
  - "End round after hole {lastHoleNumber}?"
  - "Ended after {N} of {M}": the label and the banner, where M = `getHoleCount(nineType)`.
  - "Finish": the banner action on scoring screens.
  - "This round won't count towards your handicap index."
  - "This round was already ended after {N} holes on another device."
- **UI rules (CLAUDE.md):**
  - colours come from `useThemeColors()`; static tokens are imported from `@/constants/theme`;
  - **never** use Paper `Button` (use `TouchableOpacity`);
  - every RN `<Modal>` / `presentation: 'modal'` subtree is wrapped in `<SystemModalTheme>`;
  - touch targets are ≥ 44px.
- **Offline-first:** ending early and submitting must work with no network. Server writes are queued, and the sync service runs app-wide (A6b).
- **Scoring guardrails (CLAUDE.md).** Before editing any file under `src/services/scoring`, `src/store/{scorecardStore,scoreUpdateSlice,initializeRoundSlice}.ts`, the shared scoring utils or `src/components/scorecard/**`:
  1. read `docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md`;
  2. run the `scoring-impact-analyst` agent on the file (if you're a subagent that can't start agents, the orchestrator runs it per task group; the "Scoring guardrail notes" summarise planning-time findings);
  3. lock unprotected behaviour with a characterization test **before** changing it.
- **Test subset.** Run after every task:
  ```bash
  pnpm test --testPathPattern='(golden|parity|services/scoring|utils/(scoring|dailyHandicap|subMatches|scorecardCalculations|holeTransformers|adjustedGross|matchMargin|matchPlayResult|handicapEligibility|roundShape|endRoundEarly)|components/scorecard|store/|services/offline|services/handicap|services/rounds|integration/(scoringFlow|matchPlayScorecard)|hooks/scorecard|MatchPlayScoringScreen|MatchPlayScorecardScreen|TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen|ReviewScorecardScreen|SubMatchLeaderboardTab|subMatchLeaderboard|skins|wolf)'
  ```
  Expected: all green, apart from pre-existing failures recorded in Task 0. Then run `pnpm type-check`. Run `pnpm verify:gate` at the end of each Part.
- **Snippets are intent; tests are the contract.** Line numbers are from planning time. If a quoted "Current" snippet doesn't match exactly, apply the same change to the code as it stands. Never re-introduce code an earlier task removed.
- **Git:**
  - work only in this worktree (`.claude/worktrees/end-round-early`, branch `worktree-end-round-early`);
  - commit after each task, and end every commit message with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`;

## Review Focus

These are the input classes most likely to bite a real user that the spec implies but no other test covers. Each line names the task whose tests pin it.

1. **Ending offline, then a relaunch before submitting.** The app is killed with no signal. On relaunch:
   - the round reopens still ended after N, with the removed scores still gone and the tee/daily handicap intact;
   - the scoring screens show the "Ended after N of M · Finish" banner and don't accept scores after N;
   - the queued `end_early` item reaches the server once online.

   **Test owners:** B3c (init from SQLite cards with `holes_played`, no server `holes_played` yet), B6d (scoring screen closed state), B6b (queued item).
2. **Back-9 round ended after 6.**
   - Played holes are 10–15 everywhere.
   - The RPC trims rows for holes > 15, not > 6.
   - The label reads "Ended after 6 of 9".

   **Test owners:** B2 (`filterPlayableHoles`, `lastPlayedHoleNumber`) and B1a (verification script).
3. **Two phones that both score everyone.** Phone A ends after 6, and phone B tries to end after 8.
   - B's RPC is refused with `22023`.
   - B adopts N = 6: its scores after 6 are removed and it shows "already ended … on another device".
   - Submit readiness checks holes 1–6 only, so mismatches on those holes are still caught.

   **Test owners:** B1a (RPC conflict), B6c (hook adopts the server N), B8 (readiness limited to played holes).
4. **Pickup on the boundary hole.** A pickup on hole N counts as complete, so N includes it. A pickup alone on hole N+1 is removed. **Test owner:** B2 (`planEndRoundEarly`).
5. **A co-player on an old app version opens Home after the round was ended early.** The card's differential stays NULL, and existing part-filled Quick Score cards stop counting. **Test owners:** A7 and B1a (trigger verification scripts), A3 (index/history belt).

## Interface Contract

Every task uses exactly these names and types. A task that **produces** an item creates it; tasks that **consume** it import it as written.

### Pure utilities

```ts
// src/utils/holeTransformers.ts  (B2) — beside filterHolesByNineType
/** filterHolesByNineType, then — when holesPlayed is a positive integer — sort by hole number and keep the
 *  first `holesPlayed`. null/undefined/<=0 ⇒ identical to filterHolesByNineType (no sort). */
export function filterPlayableHoles(holes: Hole[], nineType: NineType, holesPlayed?: number | null): Hole[];

// src/utils/roundShape.ts  (B2, new)
export interface RoundShape { nineType: NineType; holesPlayed: number | null }
/** Server wins when it has holes_played; else the local value (SQLite cards). nineType: server → local → 'full'. */
export function resolveRoundShape(
  server: { nine_type?: NineType | null; holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined,
  local?: { nineType?: NineType | null; holesPlayed?: number | null } | null,
): RoundShape;
export function firstHoleNumber(nineType: NineType): number;                          // back9 ⇒ 10, else 1
export function lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType: NineType, holesPlayed: number): number; // firstHoleNumber + N − 1
export function isHoleAfterEarlyEnd(nineType: NineType, holesPlayed: number | null | undefined, holeNumber: number): boolean;
export function isEndedEarly(round: { holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined): boolean;
export function formatEndedEarlyLabel(holesPlayed: number, nineType: NineType): string;   // "Ended after 6 of 9"

// src/utils/endRoundEarly.ts  (B2, new; B6a adds describeEndRoundEarlyResult)
export interface EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore { playerId: string; playerName: string; holeNumber: number }
export interface EndRoundEarlyPlan {
  holesPlayed: number;       // N
  plannedHoles: number;      // getHoleCount(nineType)
  nineType: NineType;
  lastHoleNumber: number;    // lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, N)
  removedScores: EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore[];
}
export function isHoleScored(score: HoleScore | MultiBallHoleScore | null | undefined): boolean; // strokes > 0 (any ball)
/** null when no hole is complete for every player, or when every planned hole is complete. */
export function planEndRoundEarly(input: {
  holes: Hole[];             // planned holes (store `holes`)
  nineType: NineType;
  players: { id: string; name: string }[];
  scorecards: Map<string, { scores: Scorecard['scores'] }>;
}): EndRoundEarlyPlan | null;

// src/utils/handicapEligibility.ts  (A3, new)
/** Planned holes come from getHoleRange(nineType) — NEVER from a hole list.
 *  scores null/undefined/{} (no per-hole data) ⇒ true (legacy gross-only card).
 *  Otherwise true iff every hole in the range has strokes > 0 (number or {strokes}; multi-ball: any ball). */
export function isCompleteForHandicap(scores: Record<string | number, unknown> | null | undefined, nineType: NineType): boolean;

// src/utils/matchPlayResult.ts  (A1b produces; B5a adds holesPlayed + resolveEndedAfter)
export interface StandaloneMatchResult { winnerId: string | null; winnerName: string; margin: string }
export function computeStandaloneMatchResult(
  p1: ScorecardForMatchPlay, p2: ScorecardForMatchPlay, holes: Hole[], holesPlayed?: number | null,
): StandaloneMatchResult | null;
// src/utils/matchMargin.ts  (A1a-1 adds)
export function compactMatchMargin(margin: string): string;   // '5 & 4' → '5&4', '2 up' → '2 UP', 'All Square' → 'A/S'

// src/utils/skins/holeCounts.ts  (A5a, new)
export interface SkinsHoleCounts { plannedHoles: number; holesPlayed: number }
export const DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS: SkinsHoleCounts;      // { plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 18 }
export function getSkinsHoleCounts(round: { nine_type?: NineType | null; holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined): SkinsHoleCounts;
export async function fetchSkinsHoleCounts(roundId: string): Promise<SkinsHoleCounts>; // reads rounds.nine_type (+ holes_played once B1a exists — A5a selects only nine_type; B1b adds holes_played)
```

### Match status (A1a fixes ordering, A2a threads totalHoles, B5a adds holesPlayed)

```ts
export function calculateMatchStatus(holeResults: Record<number, HoleResult>, totalHoles: number = 18, holesPlayed?: number | null): MatchStatus;
export function calculateTeamMatchStatus(holeResults: Record<number, TeamHoleResult>, totalHoles: number = 18, holesPlayed?: number | null): TeamMatchStatus;
```

- `totalHoles` is always the **planned** count.
- The engines' existing local `holesPlayed` counter is renamed `decidedHoles` (B5a).
- With `holesPlayed`, the engine walks the holes in order. The first close-out against the planned holes stands. Otherwise the final lead after `holesPlayed` decided holes wins (`'N up'` / `'All Square'`).

### Handicap (A3, A7)

```ts
// src/services/handicap/recalculateScorecardDifferential.ts
export interface RecalculationResult { /* existing fields */ handicapDifferential: number | null }
// Incomplete card: writes handicap_differential = null, still updates daily_handicap_used / total_points,
// returns handicapDifferential: null. Never throws for this.
```

- **Index belt (A3):** `updatePlayerHandicapIndex` and `fetchHandicapHistory` select `scores` and skip cards where `!isCompleteForHandicap(scores, round.nine_type ?? 'full')`.
- **B10c** adds the `holes_played` belts:
  - the index, history and recalc-candidate queries use `.is('rounds.holes_played', null)`;
  - `recalculateScorecardDifferential` (an ended-early round counts as incomplete);
  - `combineHandicapRounds.validateAndBuildContext` and `loadCombinedAndPairs`.
- **A3b** is a SQLite local migration that keeps the sync metadata on `scorecards` (`sync_nine_type TEXT`, `sync_holes TEXT` JSON, `sync_game_type TEXT`). `ScorecardDAO` round-trips `syncNineType` / `syncHoles` / `syncGameType`, so the fallback sync path no longer judges a front-9 card as `'full'`.
- **A7** is the migration `supabase/migrations/20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql`:
  - **`scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(p_scores JSONB, p_nine_type TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN`**, `IMMUTABLE`. It mirrors `isCompleteForHandicap`: `{}`/null ⇒ true; otherwise every hole in 1–18 / 1–9 / 10–18 has strokes > 0 (single-ball `{"n":{"strokes":k}}`, or a number, or multi-ball `balls[]`).
  - **Trigger `scorecards_full_card_differential`** (`BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE`): `NEW.handicap_differential := NULL` when the round's `nine_type` makes the card incomplete.
  - **Trigger `handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards`** (`BEFORE INSERT`): raises when either card is incomplete.
  - **One-off `UPDATE`:** nulls existing incomplete cards' differentials.
  - **Report script:** `supabase/scripts/full_scorecards_only_report.sql`.
  - **Verification script:** `supabase/tests/full_scorecards_only_handicap.verify.sql` (`BEGIN … ROLLBACK`).
- **B1a** extends both triggers: a round with `holes_played IS NOT NULL` also forces NULL / raises.

### Round finalisation and sync (A6; B6b adds `'end_early'`)

```ts
// src/services/rounds/finalizeRoundStatus.ts — returns boolean; false (no throw) on 0-row RLS refusal; THROWS on any read error
export async function finalizeRoundStatus(roundId: string): Promise<boolean>;
// src/services/rounds/finalizeSubmittedRound.ts  (A6a, new)
export async function finalizeSubmittedRound(roundId: string): Promise<{ completed: boolean; skinsGame: SkinsGame | null }>;
export async function queueRoundFinalize(roundId: string): Promise<void>;
export class RoundNotReadyError extends Error {}
// PendingSync round item data:
export type RoundSyncData =
  | { id: string; action: 'finalize' }
  | { id: string; action: 'end_early'; holesPlayed: number };   // (B6b)
// src/services/offline/dao/SyncQueueDAO.ts (A6a)
export async function hasUnsyncedScorecardsForRound(roundId: string): Promise<boolean>; // queued/pending card rows only
// src/services/offline/sync/drain.ts  (A6b, new — no static import of syncOrchestrator)
export function requestSyncDrain(reason: string): void;   // no-op offline; debounced
// src/services/offline/sync/syncOrchestrator.ts (A6b)
export function ensureSyncServiceStarted(): void;         // idempotent; app root calls it after initDatabase
// src/hooks/rounds/useFinalizeSubmittedRound.ts  (A6c, new)
export async function finalizeOrQueueRound(roundId: string): Promise<{ completed: boolean; queued: boolean; skinsGame: SkinsGame | null }>;
export function useFinalizeSubmittedRound(): (roundId: string) => Promise<{ completed: boolean; queued: boolean }>;
```

- **Drain order:**
  1. card uploads (queue);
  2. the SQLite fallback uploads;
  3. `round` items, with `'end_early'` before `'finalize'` for the same round.
- **A `round` item checks `hasUnsyncedScorecardsForRound` first.** If true, it throws `RoundNotReadyError`: no retry is spent and the item stays queued. If the round's only unconfirmed cards are retained `failed` rows, the round item is marked failed too.
- **`finalizeSubmittedRound` invalidates `roundKeys.all`.**

### Database (B1a)

Migration `supabase/migrations/20261007000200_end_round_early.sql`:

- **Column:** `rounds.holes_played SMALLINT NULL CHECK (holes_played IS NULL OR (competition_id IS NULL AND holes_played > 0 AND holes_played < CASE nine_type WHEN 'full' THEN 18 ELSE 9 END))`.
- **Function:** `end_round_early(p_round_id UUID, p_holes_played INT) RETURNS VOID`, `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`, `REVOKE … FROM PUBLIC`, `GRANT EXECUTE … TO authenticated`. Error codes:
  - `P0002`: the round doesn't exist or is deleted;
  - `42501`: not standalone, or the caller isn't the owner or an **accepted** participant (`is_accepted_round_participant`);
  - `22023`: N is outside 1…planned−1, **or** `holes_played` is already set to a different N, **or** the round is `completed` with a different/NULL `holes_played`.
- **Idempotent:** the same N again is a no-op success.
- **Effects:**
  - sets `holes_played = N`;
  - deletes the round's `skins_results`, `wolf_hole_decisions`, `score_entries`, `score_mismatches` and `shot_log` with `hole_number > last` (last = (back9 ? 9 : 0) + N);
  - sets `handicap_differential = NULL` on the round's scorecards.
- **Triggers:** extends A7's two triggers with the `holes_played` condition.
- **Activity feed:** `get_activity_feed` / `get_round_feed_card` are **dropped and recreated** from `20260905000150_ugc_moderation_feed.sql`, with `holes_played INT` and `nine_type TEXT` added. COMMENTs and grants are re-added.
- **Apply:** `psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -f …`.

TS (B1b):
- `Round.holes_played?: number | null`;
- `SupabaseRoundData.holes_played` and `ROUND_METADATA_SELECT`;
- `RoundMetadata.holesPlayed: number | null`;
- `ActivityFeedCard.holes_played?` / `nine_type?`;
- the typed `end_round_early` RPC (`p_round_id`, `p_holes_played`);
- `fetchSkinsHoleCounts` also selects `holes_played`.

### Local state and store (B3)

```ts
// SQLite local migration (B3a): scorecards.holes_played INTEGER NULL.
// src/types/index.ts — Scorecard (camel)
holesPlayed?: number | null;          // set on every card of the round when it is ended; persisted; read by sync for net
// src/services/offline/dao/HoleScoreDAO.ts (+ re-export from src/services/offline/database.ts)
export async function deleteHoleScoresForCards(entries: { scorecardId: string; holeNumbers: number[] }[]): Promise<void>; // ONE transaction

// src/store/scorecardStore.ts (logic in src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts)
holesPlayed: number | null;           // reset to null by resetRound
/** Idempotent. Removes every score after lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, n) on every card (one SQLite transaction,
 *  BEFORE any state change), stamps holesPlayed = n and teeData = the player's tee on every card, recomputes totals,
 *  persists, sets store holesPlayed = n, schedules snapshot syncs. Throws (changing nothing) if the device doesn't
 *  score every player or the delete fails. Used by confirm, conflict adoption and init reconcile. */
endRoundEarly: (n: number) => Promise<void>;
getPlayedHoles: () => Hole[];         // filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, holesPlayed)
// src/store/scoreUpdateSlice.ts
// applyScoreUpdate returns Scorecard | null — null (no-op) when the hole is after the early end OR not in `holes`.
// multiBallSlice setters apply the same guard.
```

- **Init (B3c):** `initializeRound` and `loadFromOffline` resolve the shape with `resolveRoundShape(serverRow, { nineType, holesPlayed: max(cards' holesPlayed) })`. When `holesPlayed` is set and any card holds a score after N, they call `endRoundEarly(N)` (reconcile). `initializeRound` takes an optional `holesPlayed` param.
- **Guards:** the `useRoundData` / `useMatchPlayData` mismatch guards compare `holesPlayed` as well as `nineType`.
- **Watch:** it gets `getPlayedHoles()`, and a write the guard drops reports failure.

## Needs Sam
Nothing blocks the plan. Two decisions were made during integration; please check them:
- **A3-2 clears a stale index.** When no qualifying differential remains, `updatePlayerHandicapIndex` writes `handicap_index = NULL`, but only on a row that still holds one. The column is purely computed (only this service writes it, signup inserts NULL, migration `20260629000000` already NULLs it). When it is NULL, the playing handicap falls back to the profile handicap (`scorecardCalculations.ts:113`) and the UI shows "—".

## End-early RPC and client
- **RPC errors** [B1a-1]:
  - `42501`: unauthenticated, a competition round, or not the owner / an accepted participant;
  - `P0002`: missing or deleted round;
  - `22023` with HINT `invalid_holes_played`, `round_already_ended` (`DETAIL` = the server's N) or `round_completed`. The same N again returns at once, without re-trimming.
- **`applyEndRoundEarly` maps those errors** [B6b-1]:
  - `22023` + `round_already_ended` → `'conflict'`, with `serverHolesPlayed` = `Number(details)`, else `fetchRoundHolesPlayed` (`undefined` if that read fails);
  - other `22023`, `22P02`, `23514` and bad arguments → `'invalid'`;
  - `42501` → `'forbidden'`; `P0002` → `'not_found'`; anything else → `'network'`. The error is built as `EndRoundEarlyError(code, message, { serverHolesPlayed? })`. There is one extra export, `hasQueuedRoundEndEarly(roundId)`.
- **Queue item** [B6b-2]: `conflict` / `not_found` are removed; `forbidden` / `invalid` / malformed throw `RoundSyncPermanentError`; `network` retries normally. The item never waits for cards.
- **`useEndRoundEarly`** [B6c-1]:
  - checks `checkIsOnline()` at confirm;
  - on a conflict, adopts `serverHolesPlayed` (else re-reads it);
  - after an RPC success or an adopted conflict, invalidates `skinsKeys.holeCounts(id)` and `roundKeys.detail(id)` through the `queryClient` singleton.
- **B6a types** in `utils/endRoundEarly.ts`: `EndEarlyMatchContext`, `EndRoundEarlyStatsRow` and `EndRoundEarlyResultInput`. The sheet shows `displayHoleNumber(plan.lastHoleNumber, startHole)`.
- **`EndedEarlyBanner`** is produced by B6d-1, not B7a, and is exported from the barrel. B7a-2 imports it by direct path.
- **`usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId, holes, currentHole, setCurrentHole })`** [B6d-1] returns `{ isEnded, holesPlayed, nineType, navigableHoles, firstHoleNumber, lastHoleNumber }`.

## Scoring guardrail notes (from planning-time `scoring-impact-analyst` runs)

- **Daily handicap comes from the planned holes.** It is derived from Σpar of the holes passed in: the store calcs, the live `calculatePlayerStats`, and the `submitScorecards` `coursePar`. **Never pass played-only holes into a function that derives the daily handicap.** Pass planned holes plus `holesPlayed`.
- **These had no tests before this plan:**
  - `holeTransformers`;
  - the `submitScorecards` payload;
  - partial-card net;
  - `validateScores`;
  - `useTeamMatchPlayState`;
  - the round-list pill;
  - `combineHandicapRounds` / `loadCombinedAndPairs`;
  - `finalizeSkinsGame`;
  - stats aggregation.

  Each task adds characterization tests before it edits.
- **Tests that lock behaviour this plan changes on purpose:**
  - **"& 0" margins:**
    - `matchPlayCalculations.test.ts:291-298, 797-809`;
    - `teamMatchPlayCalculations.test.ts:300-305, 886-890`;
    - `integration/matchPlayScorecard.test.ts:575-579`.
  - **Gross-only differential:** `calculateHandicapData.test.ts` (`scores: {}`) and `recalculateScorecardDifferential.test.ts` (no `scores`) stay valid under the legacy rule. Add explicit tests that lock that rule.
- **Out of scope (test-only code):** `src/utils/scoring.ts` `calculateMatchPlayStatus`, `src/utils/teamScoring/matchPlay.ts` `calculateMatchPlayMatchResult` and `MatchPlayEngine` also hard-code 18 or "&0", but they have no production callers. Leave them alone.

`src/utils/matchMargin.ts`: append after `formatMatchMargin` (after line 16):

```ts

/**
 * Convert a `calculateMatchStatus` / `calculateTeamMatchStatus` margin
 * ("3 & 2", "2 up", "All Square") to the compact token above
 * ("3&2", "2 UP", "A/S"). Anything else passes through unchanged.
 */
export function compactMatchMargin(margin: string): string {
  if (margin === 'All Square') return 'A/S';
  if (margin.includes('&')) return margin.replace(/\s+/g, '');
  const up = /^(\d+)\s*up$/i.exec(margin.trim());
  return up ? `${up[1]} UP` : margin;
}
```

```ts
/** Normalise the engine's margin string to the compact display form. */
function normaliseMargin(margin: string): string {
  if (margin === 'All Square') return 'A/S';
  if (margin.includes('&')) return margin.replace(/\s+/g, ''); // '3 & 2' -> '3&2'
  if (margin.toLowerCase().endsWith('up')) return `${margin.split(' ')[0]} UP`; // '2 up' -> '2 UP'
  return margin;
}
```

- **Lines 44-102.** Replace the whole local `calculateMatchStatus` function, from its `/**\n * Calculate match status from hole results\n * Returns: …` doc comment to its closing `}` (line 102), with:

```tsx
/**
 * Header summary for the match. The match numbers come from the canonical
 * `calculateTeamMatchStatus` engine against the planned hole count — this
 * card only formats them ("Team A 2 UP", "Team A 2 UP (Dormie)",
 * "Team A wins 3&2", "All Square").
 */
function describeMatchStatus(
  holeResults: Map<number, 'team1' | 'team2' | 'halved'>,
  totalHoles: number,
  team1Name: string,
  team2Name: string
): { status: string; team1Holes: number; team2Holes: number; halved: number; winner: 'team1' | 'team2' | null } {
  const results: Record<number, TeamHoleResult> = {};
  holeResults.forEach((winner, holeNumber) => {
    results[holeNumber] = {
      team1Score: null,
      team2Score: null,
      team1PlayerScores: {},
      team2PlayerScores: {},
      winner,
    };
  });

  const { team1: team1Holes, team2: team2Holes, halved } = countHolesWon(results);
  const matchStatus = calculateTeamMatchStatus(results, totalHoles);
  const nameFor = (team: 'team1' | 'team2') => (team === 'team1' ? team1Name : team2Name);

  if (matchStatus.status === 'complete') {
    if (matchStatus.winner === 'halved') {
      return { status: 'All Square', team1Holes, team2Holes, halved, winner: null };
    }
    return {
      status: `${nameFor(matchStatus.winner)} wins ${compactMatchMargin(matchStatus.margin)}`,
      team1Holes,
      team2Holes,
      halved,
      winner: matchStatus.winner,
    };
  }

  if (matchStatus.leader === null) {
    return { status: 'All Square', team1Holes, team2Holes, halved, winner: null };
  }

  // Dormie: the lead equals the holes left to play.
  const isDormie = matchStatus.holesUp === matchStatus.holesRemaining;
  return {
    status: `${nameFor(matchStatus.leader)} ${matchStatus.holesUp} UP${isDormie ? ' (Dormie)' : ''}`,
    team1Holes,
    team2Holes,
    halved,
    winner: matchStatus.leader,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Rows finalised before invariant I10 stored a match won on the last hole as
 * "N & 0" (engine format, or "N&0"). There are no holes "remaining" in such a
 * result, so show it the way the engines now write it: "N up". Real
 * close-outs ("3 & 2") and every other value pass through unchanged.
 */
function normalizeFinalMargin(margin: string | null | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (margin == null) return undefined;
  return margin.replace(/^(\d+)\s*&\s*0$/, '$1 up');
}
```

Create `src/utils/matchPlayResult.ts`. The body of `computeStandaloneMatchResult` is moved verbatim from `useRoundList.ts:950-1026`; only the names and exports change:

```ts
/**
 * Standalone (social) match-play result — the round-list winner row and the
 * "You: Won 4&3" pill.
 *
 * Walks the holes in order using the difference method (`getMatchPlayStrokes`,
 * invariant I1) on each scorecard's stored `daily_handicap_used`, and stops at
 * the first close-out. Self-contained so the round list can run it without the
 * full scoring engine + course/tee context.
 */

import { getMatchPlayStrokes } from '@/utils/scoring';
import { isSingleBallScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import type { Hole, HoleScore, MultiBallHoleScore } from '@/types/database/base';

/**
 * Minimal scorecard shape the match-play result needs. Match play is decided
 * hole by hole rather than from totals, so it keeps its own slice of the row.
 */
export interface ScorecardForMatchPlay {
  player_id: string;
  scores: Record<string, HoleScore | MultiBallHoleScore> | null;
  daily_handicap_used: number | null;
  player: { id: string; name: string } | null;
}

export interface StandaloneMatchResult {
  /** Winner's player id; null when halved. */
  winnerId: string | null;
  /** Winner's name, or 'Halved'. */
  winnerName: string;
  /** Compact margin token. */
  margin: string;
}

/**
 * Compute a two-player match result from raw scorecards and the round's
 * holes. Returns null when no hole has a score from both players.
 */
export function computeStandaloneMatchResult(
  p1: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  p2: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  holes: Hole[]
): StandaloneMatchResult | null {
  const dhc1 = p1.daily_handicap_used ?? 0;
  const dhc2 = p2.daily_handicap_used ?? 0;

  const sortedHoles = [...holes].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
  const totalHoles = sortedHoles.length;

  let player1Up = 0;
  let holesPlayed = 0;

  for (const hole of sortedHoles) {
    const score1 = p1.scores?.[String(hole.number)];
    const score2 = p2.scores?.[String(hole.number)];
    const gross1 =
      score1 && isSingleBallScore(score1) && score1.strokes > 0
        ? score1.strokes
        : null;
    const gross2 =
      score2 && isSingleBallScore(score2) && score2.strokes > 0
        ? score2.strokes
        : null;
    if (gross1 == null || gross2 == null) continue;

    // Difference method: the lower-DHC player plays off scratch and the
    // higher-DHC player receives the difference on this hole.
    const { a: strokes1, b: strokes2 } = getMatchPlayStrokes(
      dhc1,
      dhc2,
      hole.strokeIndex
    );

    const net1 = gross1 - strokes1;
    const net2 = gross2 - strokes2;

    holesPlayed++;
    if (net1 < net2) player1Up++;
    else if (net2 < net1) player1Up--;

    // Early finish — match is decided when lead > holes remaining
    const holesRemaining = totalHoles - holesPlayed;
    if (Math.abs(player1Up) > holesRemaining) {
      const winnerId = player1Up > 0 ? p1.player_id : p2.player_id;
      const winnerName =
        (player1Up > 0 ? p1.player?.name : p2.player?.name) ?? 'Unknown';
      return {
        winnerId,
        winnerName,
        margin: `${Math.abs(player1Up)}&${holesRemaining}`,
      };
    }
  }

  if (holesPlayed === 0) return null;

  if (player1Up === 0) {
    return { winnerId: null, winnerName: 'Halved', margin: 'A/S' };
  }

  const absLead = Math.abs(player1Up);
  const winnerId = player1Up > 0 ? p1.player_id : p2.player_id;
  const winnerName =
    (player1Up > 0 ? p1.player?.name : p2.player?.name) ?? 'Unknown';
  const margin =
    holesPlayed === totalHoles
      ? `${absLead}up`
      : `${absLead}&${totalHoles - holesPlayed}`;

  return { winnerId, winnerName, margin };
}
```

```ts
import {

const HOLES = create18Holes();
const FRONT_NINE = HOLES.filter((h) => h.number <= 9);

/** A scorecard with `strokes` keyed by hole number (as the DB stores them). */
function card(
  playerId: string,
  name: string | null,
  strokesByHole: Record<number, number>,
  dailyHandicap: number | null = 0
): ScorecardForMatchPlay {
  const scores: NonNullable<ScorecardForMatchPlay['scores']> = {};
  for (const [hole, strokes] of Object.entries(strokesByHole)) {
    scores[hole] = { strokes };
  }
  return {
    player_id: playerId,
    scores,
    daily_handicap_used: dailyHandicap,
    player: name ? { id: playerId, name } : null,
  };
}

/** The same stroke count on holes `from`..`to` inclusive. */
function range(from: number, to: number, strokes: number): Record<number, number> {
  const out: Record<number, number> = {};
  for (let h = from; h <= to; h++) out[h] = strokes;
  return out;
}

describe('computeStandaloneMatchResult — current behaviour (characterization)', () => {

    const dave = card('p2', 'Dave', range(1, 18, 4));
    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, dave, HOLES)).toEqual({
      winnerId: null,
      winnerName: 'Halved',
      margin: 'A/S',
    });
  });

    const dave = card('p2', 'Dave', { ...range(1, 10, 5), ...range(11, 18, 3) });
    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, dave, HOLES)).toEqual({
      winnerId: 'p1',
      winnerName: 'Sam',

    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, dave, HOLES)?.margin).toBe('1&9');
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The holes a standalone match is played over: the course card narrowed to
 * the round's nine. `nineType` comes from an untyped list row, so anything
 * other than 'front9' / 'back9' (including null) means the full 18.
 */
export function standaloneMatchHoles(
  courseHoles: Hole[],
  nineType: string | null | undefined
): Hole[] {
  const nine: NineType = nineType === 'front9' || nineType === 'back9' ? nineType : 'full';
  return filterHolesByNineType(courseHoles, nine);
}
```

```ts
/** Winner + compact margin for a final `player1Up` lead with `holesRemaining` unplayed. */
function toResult(
  p1: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  p2: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  player1Up: number,
  holesRemaining: number
): StandaloneMatchResult {
  if (player1Up === 0) {
    return { winnerId: null, winnerName: 'Halved', margin: formatMatchMargin(0, 0, true) };
  }
  const leader = player1Up > 0 ? p1 : p2;
  return {
    winnerId: leader.player_id,
    winnerName: leader.player?.name ?? 'Unknown',
    margin: formatMatchMargin(Math.abs(player1Up), holesRemaining, false),
  };
}
```

```ts
  wonHoles: number[]
```

```ts
    Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => ({ number: first + i, par: 4, strokeIndex: i + 1 }) as Hole);
```

Run the `scoring-impact-analyst` agent on `TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen/hooks/useTeamMatchPlayState.ts`. Expected blast radius:

Without it, a 9-hole Σpar paired with the 18-hole course rating would inflate the team screen's daily handicap. }));

```ts
type Winner = 'team1' | 'team2' | 'halved' | null;

interface HoleProps {
  currentHole: number;
  currentHoleWinner: Winner;

function buildTeam(id: string, name: string, memberIds: string[]): MatchTeam {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    handicap: 0,
    members: memberIds.map((memberId) => ({
      id: memberId,
      name: memberId,
      handicap: 0,
      score: null,
      pickedUp: false,
    })),
  };
}

const reds = buildTeam('t1', 'Reds', ['a1', 'a2']);
const blues = buildTeam('t2', 'Blues', ['b1', 'b2']);
const getPlayerScoreValue = () => 4;

function renderState(totalHoles: number, firstHole = 1) {
  return renderHook(
    ({ currentHole, currentHoleWinner }: HoleProps) =>
      useTeamMatchPlayState({
        team1: reds,
        team2: blues,
        currentHole,
        team1BestScore: 4,

        getPlayerScoreValue,

  );
}

/** Swipe through holes in order, recording each hole's winner as the screen does. */
function playHoles(rerender: (props: HoleProps) => void, firstHole: number, winners: Winner[]) {

}
```

Create `src/screens/scoring/TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen/utils/matchHoles.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Hole list + navigation bounds for a team match.
 *
 * Team match play rounds can be front9 / back9; the hole list is the course's
 * holes (or the default card) narrowed to the round's nine, and the bounds
 * come from that list — back-9 runs 10..18.
 */

import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { getHoleRange } from '@/constants/scoring';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { DEFAULT_HOLES } from '../constants';

export interface MatchHoles {
  /** The round's planned holes for its nine. */
  holes: Hole[];
  firstHoleNumber: number;
  lastHoleNumber: number;
}

export function resolveMatchHoles(
  courseHoles: Hole[] | null | undefined,
  nineType: NineType
): MatchHoles {
  const source = Array.isArray(courseHoles) ? courseHoles : DEFAULT_HOLES;
  const holes = filterHolesByNineType(source, nineType);
  const range = getHoleRange(nineType);
  return {
    holes,
    firstHoleNumber: holes[0]?.number ?? range.start,
    lastHoleNumber: holes[holes.length - 1]?.number ?? range.end,
  };
}
```

```ts
/** `{ strokes }` on each listed hole, keyed by number as the store does. */
function scored(holes: number[], strokes = 4): Record<number, unknown> {
  const scores: Record<number, unknown> = {};
  for (const hole of holes) scores[hole] = { strokes };
  return scores;
}

describe('isCompleteForHandicap', () => {
  describe('legacy cards with no per-hole data', () => {
    it.each([null, undefined, {}])('treats %p as complete (gross-only rule)', (scores) => {

      expect(isCompleteForHandicap(scores, 'back9')).toBe(true);

    });

    it('counts a pickup as scored', () => {

    it('judges a back-9 card on holes 10–18 only', () => {
      expect(isCompleteForHandicap(scored(range(10, 18)), 'back9')).toBe(true);

    it('is incomplete for a back-9 round ended after 6 holes (10–15)', () => {
      expect(isCompleteForHandicap(scored(range(10, 15)), 'back9')).toBe(false);
    });

    it('is incomplete for a back-9 round whose scores sit on holes 1–9', () => {

    });

    it('ignores scores outside the planned nine', () => {
      const scores = scored(range(1, 9));

    it('reads the planned holes from the nine type, not from what was scored', () => {

    });
  });

  describe('score shapes', () => {
    it('accepts bare numbers', () => {
      const scores: Record<number, number> = {};
      for (const hole of range(1, 9)) scores[hole] = 5;
      expect(isCompleteForHandicap(scores, 'front9')).toBe(true);

    it('accepts string keys from Supabase JSONB', () => {
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the predicate**

```ts
// src/utils/handicapEligibility.ts
/**
 * Handicap Eligibility — the card-level completeness gate (invariant I12)
 *
 * Only a FULL scorecard earns a WHS Score Differential: every hole of the
 * round's planned nine or eighteen carries a score. A partial card — a social
 * round ended early, a part-filled Quick Score card, a half-scored nine —
 * would otherwise yield a wildly low differential (an 18-hole round ended
 * after 6 holes comes out around −38) and poison the handicap index.
 *
 * Card-based on purpose: it reads the card's own scores and the round's planned
 * nine type — never a hole list — so it holds whatever hole list a caller has
 * in scope, and it works offline before any round-level write reaches the
 * server.
 *
 * Mirrored on the server by public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap()
 * (supabase/migrations/20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql).
 * Keep the two in step.
 *
 * Legacy cards with no per-hole data at all keep the old gross-only behaviour
 * (treated as complete).
 *
 * @see docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md (I8 differential call sites)
 */

import { getHoleRange } from '@/constants/scoring';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

/**
 * Whether one stored hole score carries a stroke count. Accepts every shape a
 * card may hold: a bare number, a `{ strokes }` object (app or JSONB), or a
 * multi-ball `{ balls: [...] }` (scored when any ball is). A pickup is stored as
 * strokes = PICKUP_SCORE, so it counts as scored; a did-not-attempt hole is
 * stored as strokes = 0, so it does not.
 */
function hasStrokes(raw: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof raw === 'number') return raw > 0;
  if (raw == null || typeof raw !== 'object') return false;
  const { balls, strokes } = raw as { balls?: unknown; strokes?: unknown };
  if (Array.isArray(balls)) return balls.some((ball) => hasStrokes(ball));
  return typeof strokes === 'number' && strokes > 0;
}

/**
 * True when the card is complete for handicap purposes: every planned hole
 * (`getHoleRange(nineType)`) has a score. A card with no per-hole data at all
 * (null / undefined / no keys) is a legacy gross-only card and returns true.
 */
export function isCompleteForHandicap(
  scores: Record<string | number, unknown> | null | undefined,
  nineType: NineType,
): boolean {
  if (!scores || Object.keys(scores).length === 0) return true;
  const { start, end } = getHoleRange(nineType);
  for (let hole = start; hole <= end; hole++) {
    if (!hasStrokes(scores[hole])) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
```

```ts
describe('calculateHandicapData — handicap completeness gate (I12)', () => {
  const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
    Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

  /** Level par on the listed holes only. */
  function parScoresOn(holeNumbers: number[]): Record<number, { strokes: number }> {
    const scores: Record<number, { strokes: number }> = {};
    for (const n of holeNumbers) scores[n] = { strokes: PAR_72_HOLES[n - 1].par };
    return scores;
  }

  // Scratch player, as in the cap block above: daily handicap −1, so no strokes
  // are received and every hole caps at par + 2 = 6.
  const scratchCard = (overrides: Partial<Scorecard>) =>
    makeScorecard({ playerHandicap: 0, syncHoles: PAR_72_HOLES, coursePar: 72, ...overrides });

  const BACK_NINE = PAR_72_HOLES.filter((h) => h.number >= 10);

  it('keeps the legacy gross-only rule for a card with no per-hole data (I12 lock)', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(makeScorecard({ scores: {}, totalGross: 90 }));
    // (113 / 122) × (90 − 71) = 17.6
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeCloseTo(17.6, 1);
  });

  it('computes a differential for a complete 18-hole card (I12 lock)', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({ scores: parScoresOn(range(1, 18)), totalGross: 72 }),
    );
    // (113 / 122) × (72 − 71) = 0.9
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeCloseTo(0.9, 1);
  });

  it('counts a pickup as a scored hole (I12 lock)', () => {
    const scores = parScoresOn(range(1, 18));
    scores[7] = { strokes: PICKUP_SCORE };
    // Gross 17 × 4 + 10 = 78; the pickup caps at net double bogey (6):
    // adjusted 68 + 6 = 74 → (113 / 122) × (74 − 71) = 2.8
    const result = calculateHandicapData(scratchCard({ scores, totalGross: 78 }));
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeCloseTo(2.8, 1);
  });

  it('computes a differential for a complete back-9 card (I12 lock)', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({
        syncNineType: 'back9',
        syncHoles: BACK_NINE,
        coursePar: 36,
        scores: parScoresOn(range(10, 18)),
        totalGross: 36,
      }),
    );
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns a NULL differential for an 18-hole card scored on only 6 holes', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({ scores: parScoresOn(range(1, 6)), totalGross: 24 }),
    );
    // Before the gate: (113 / 122) × (24 − 71) = −43.5, straight into the index.
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeNull();
    // Only the differential is withheld — the snapshot is still recorded.
    expect(result.courseRatingUsed).toBe(71);
    expect(result.slopeRatingUsed).toBe(122);
    expect(result.dailyHandicapUsed).toBe(-1);
  });

  it('returns a NULL differential for a back-9 card scored on holes 10–15 only', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({
        syncNineType: 'back9',
        syncHoles: BACK_NINE,
        coursePar: 36,
        scores: parScoresOn(range(10, 15)),
        totalGross: 24,
      }),
    );
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns a NULL differential when completeness is judged from the nine type, not syncHoles', () => {
    // syncHoles lists only holes 1–6, but the round is a full 18.
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({
        syncHoles: PAR_72_HOLES.slice(0, 6),
        scores: parScoresOn(range(1, 6)),
        totalGross: 24,
      }),
    );
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
      Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

    function bogeyScores(holeNumbers: number[]): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {

      for (const n of holeNumbers) {
        scores[String(n)] = { strokes: mockRound.courses.holes[n - 1].par + 1 };
      }
      return scores;
```

```ts
  // 8. Calculate differential from the WHS ADJUSTED gross score — every hole
  // capped at net double bogey (par + 2 + strokes received). Falls back to the
  // raw total_gross when hole data is unavailable, which is what this call site
  // used before the cap was introduced.
  //
  // Handicap completeness gate (I12): an incomplete card — an early-ended or
  // part-filled round, or an in-progress card recalculated by mid-round Change
  // Tees — gets a NULL differential instead of an error, so the daily handicap
  // and points snapshot below still refresh. Cards with no per-hole data keep
  // the legacy gross-only rule.
  const isCompleteCard = isCompleteForHandicap(scorecard.scores, nineType);
  let handicapDifferential: number | null = null;

  if (isCompleteCard) {
    const adjustedGross =
      effectiveHoles.length > 0 && scorecard.scores
        ? calculateAdjustedGrossScore({
            holes: effectiveHoles,
            scores: scorecard.scores as AdjustedGrossParams['scores'],
            dailyHandicap: dailyHandicapUsed ?? 0,
          }).adjustedGross
        : scorecard.total_gross;

      adjustedGrossScore: adjustedGross > 0 ? adjustedGross : scorecard.total_gross,
      courseRating: ratings.courseRating,
      slopeRating: ratings.slopeRating,
    });

    if (handicapDifferential === null) {
      throw new Error('Failed to calculate differential from current ratings');
    }
  }
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/api/leagueMutations.test.ts
/**
 * tagRoundToLeague — handicap completeness gate (I12)
 *
 * A league row stores the WHS differential, so only a complete 18-hole card
 * may be tagged. The 18-hole check runs BEFORE any retroactive recalculation,
 * and a recalculation that withholds the differential refuses the tag.
 */

const mockGetUser = jest.fn();
const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: {
    auth: { getUser: () => mockGetUser() },
    from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args),
  },
}));

const mockRecalculate = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/handicap/recalculateScorecardDifferential', () => ({
  recalculateScorecardDifferential: (...args: unknown[]) => mockRecalculate(...args),
}));

import { tagRoundToLeague } from '@/services/api/leagues/mutations';

const USER_ID = 'user-1';
const LEAGUE_ID = 'league-1';
const SCORECARD_ID = 'scorecard-1';

function scoresOn(holeCount: number): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (let hole = 1; hole <= holeCount; hole++) scores[String(hole)] = { strokes: 5 };
  return scores;
}

function makeScorecard(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    id: SCORECARD_ID,
    player_id: USER_ID,
    handicap_differential: null,
    status: 'completed',
    scores: scoresOn(18),
    round_id: 'round-1',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function recalcResult(handicapDifferential: number | null) {
  return {
    handicapDifferential,
    dailyHandicapUsed: 19,
    courseRatingUsed: 72.5,
    slopeRatingUsed: 125,
    gaHandicapUsed: 18,
  };
}

let leagueRoundInserts: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];

function wireTables(scorecard: Record<string, unknown>) {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) => {
    switch (table) {
      case 'scorecards':
        return {
          select: () => ({
            eq: () => ({ single: () => Promise.resolve({ data: scorecard, error: null }) }),
          }),
        };
      case 'leagues':
        return {
          select: () => ({
            eq: () => ({
              single: () =>
                Promise.resolve({
                  // 'ladder' has no extra tag validation (validateTagForLeagueType).
                  data: { id: LEAGUE_ID, status: 'active', league_type: 'ladder' },
                  error: null,
                }),
            }),
          }),
        };
      case 'league_rounds':
        return {
          insert: (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => {
            leagueRoundInserts.push(payload);
            return {
              select: () => ({
                single: () => Promise.resolve({ data: { id: 'league-round-1', ...payload }, error: null }),
              }),
            };
          },
        };
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unexpected table: ${table}`);
    }
  });
}

describe('tagRoundToLeague — handicap completeness gate', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    leagueRoundInserts = [];
    mockGetUser.mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: { id: USER_ID } }, error: null });
    mockRecalculate.mockResolvedValue(recalcResult(-38.4));
  });

  it('tags a complete card that already has a differential, without recalculating (I12 lock)', async () => {
    wireTables(makeScorecard({ handicap_differential: 14.2 }));

    await tagRoundToLeague(LEAGUE_ID, SCORECARD_ID);

    expect(mockRecalculate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(leagueRoundInserts).toEqual([
      { league_id: LEAGUE_ID, scorecard_id: SCORECARD_ID, player_id: USER_ID, handicap_differential: 14.2 },
    ]);
  });

  it('tags with the recalculated differential when none was stored (I12 lock)', async () => {
    mockRecalculate.mockResolvedValue(recalcResult(12.3));
    wireTables(makeScorecard());

    await tagRoundToLeague(LEAGUE_ID, SCORECARD_ID);

    expect(mockRecalculate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(SCORECARD_ID);
    expect(leagueRoundInserts[0].handicap_differential).toBe(12.3);
  });

  it('wraps a failed recalculation (I12 lock)', async () => {
    mockRecalculate.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Tee still has no valid slope/course ratings'));
    wireTables(makeScorecard());

    await expect(tagRoundToLeague(LEAGUE_ID, SCORECARD_ID)).rejects.toThrow(
      'This scorecard does not have a handicap differential and recalculation failed: Tee still has no valid slope/course ratings',
    );
  });

  it('rejects a partial card before attempting any recalculation', async () => {
    wireTables(makeScorecard({ scores: scoresOn(6) }));

    await expect(tagRoundToLeague(LEAGUE_ID, SCORECARD_ID)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Only 18-hole rounds can be tagged to leagues',
    );
    expect(mockRecalculate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(leagueRoundInserts).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('refuses the tag when recalculation withholds the differential', async () => {
    mockRecalculate.mockResolvedValue(recalcResult(null));
    wireTables(makeScorecard());

    await expect(tagRoundToLeague(LEAGUE_ID, SCORECARD_ID)).rejects.toThrow(
      'This round is not eligible for a handicap differential',
    );
    expect(leagueRoundInserts).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
  // Validate the card BEFORE any recalculation: a partial card is rejected
  // outright rather than sent through recalculateScorecardDifferential, which
  // writes to the scorecard row.
  const scores = sc.scores;
  if (!scores || typeof scores !== 'object') {

  const holesWithStrokes = Object.values(scores).filter(
    (s) => s && s.strokes != null && s.strokes > 0

    // Attempt retroactive recalculation — tee data may have been updated since round was scored
    let recalculated: number | null;
    try {
      const result = await recalculateScorecardDifferential(scorecardId);
      recalculated = result.handicapDifferential;
    } catch (recalcError) {
      const msg = recalcError instanceof Error ? recalcError.message : 'Unknown error';
      throw new Error(
        `This scorecard does not have a handicap differential and recalculation failed: ${msg}`
      );
    }
    // The completeness gate (I12) can legitimately withhold a differential;
    // a league row must never be written with a null one.
    if (recalculated == null) {
      throw new Error('This round is not eligible for a handicap differential');
    }
    sc.handicap_differential = recalculated;
  }
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex.test.ts
/**
 * updatePlayerHandicapIndex — only full scorecards count (I12, R21).
 *
 * A part-filled card that still carries a stored differential (an old
 * client, or data from before the server trigger) must not reach the index.
 * Legacy cards with no per-hole data keep counting.
 */

const mockUpdates: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
const mockUpdateFilters: unknown[][][] = [];
const mockSelects: Record<string, string[]> = {};
let mockScorecardRows: unknown[] = [];

/** Chainable + thenable stub: filters pass through; awaiting resolves the table's rows. */
function mockQuery(table: string) {
  const result =
    table === 'scorecards' ? { data: mockScorecardRows, error: null } : { data: [], error: null };
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const passthrough = () => chain;
  chain.select = (columns: string) => {
    mockSelects[table] = [...(mockSelects[table] ?? []), columns];
    return chain;
  };
  chain.eq = passthrough;
  chain.in = passthrough;
  chain.not = passthrough;
  chain.is = passthrough;
  chain.order = passthrough;
  chain.limit = passthrough;
  chain.update = (values: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    mockUpdates.push(values);
    const filters: unknown[][] = [];
    mockUpdateFilters.push(filters);
    // Awaited directly (the index write) or through .select('id') (the clear,
    // which reports the rows it changed).
    const updateChain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    updateChain.eq = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      filters.push(['eq', ...args]);
      return updateChain;
    };
    updateChain.not = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      filters.push(['not', ...args]);
      return updateChain;
    };
    updateChain.select = () => Promise.resolve({ data: [{ id: 'player-1' }], error: null });
    updateChain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
      Promise.resolve({ error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
    return updateChain;
  };
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockQuery(table) },
}));

jest.mock('@/services/queryClient', () => ({
  queryClient: { invalidateQueries: jest.fn() },
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => ({
  syncLogger: { info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() },
}));

import { updatePlayerHandicapIndex } from '@/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex';

const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

/** A completed 18-hole card row as the query returns it. `null` holes = legacy `{}` card. */
function cardRow(differential: number, submittedAt: string, holeNumbers: number[] | null) {
  return {
    handicap_differential: differential,
    submitted_at: submittedAt,
    scores:
      holeNumbers === null
        ? {}
        : Object.fromEntries(holeNumbers.map((n) => [String(n), { strokes: 5 }])),
    rounds: { nine_type: 'full', game_type: 'stroke', team_format: null },
  };
}

const COMPLETE = cardRow(10.0, '2026-09-03T08:00:00Z', range(1, 18));
const LEGACY = cardRow(12.0, '2026-09-01T08:00:00Z', null);
const PARTIAL = cardRow(-38.4, '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z', range(1, 6));

describe('updatePlayerHandicapIndex — full scorecards only', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockUpdates.length = 0;
    mockUpdateFilters.length = 0;
    for (const key of Object.keys(mockSelects)) delete mockSelects[key];
  });

  it('indexes complete and legacy cards (I12 lock)', async () => {
    mockScorecardRows = [COMPLETE, LEGACY];

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    // 2 rounds → best 1: 10.0 × 0.96 = 9.6
    expect(mockUpdates).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(mockUpdates[0]).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ handicap_index: 9.6 }));
  });

  it('requests hole-by-hole scores', async () => {
    mockScorecardRows = [];

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    expect(mockSelects.scorecards[0]).toContain('scores');
  });

  it('skips a part-filled card that still carries a differential', async () => {
    mockScorecardRows = [PARTIAL, COMPLETE, LEGACY];

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    // Before the belt: best 1 of 3 = −38.4 × 0.96 = −36.9
    expect(mockUpdates[0]).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ handicap_index: 9.6 }));
  });

  it('clears a stale index when every card is incomplete', async () => {
    mockScorecardRows = [PARTIAL];

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    // Before the belt: the partial card alone → −38.4 × 0.96 = −36.9 is written.
    expect(mockUpdates).toEqual([
      { handicap_index: null, handicap_index_updated_at: expect.any(String) },
    ]);
    // Only a row that still holds an index is touched.
    expect(mockUpdateFilters[0]).toEqual([
      ['eq', 'id', 'player-1'],
      ['not', 'handicap_index', 'is', null],
    ]);
  });

  it('clears a stale index when no qualifying round remains at all', async () => {
    // e.g. the player's only differentials were part-filled cards nulled by A7.
    mockScorecardRows = [];

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    expect(mockUpdates).toEqual([
      { handicap_index: null, handicap_index_updated_at: expect.any(String) },
    ]);
  });
});
```

**Clear a stale index.** Add this function after the imports, directly above the JSDoc that starts `/**\n * Recalculate and update a player's handicap index` (which documents `updatePlayerHandicapIndex`):

```ts
/**
 * No qualifying differential remains (e.g. the player's only differentials
 * were part-filled cards, nulled by the R21 data fix): the calculated index
 * must not outlive its rounds. players.handicap_index is purely computed
 * (only this service writes it); NULL is the state a new player starts in.
 * Only a row that still holds an index is touched, so the common case (a
 * player with no rounds, every Home load) costs no write and no invalidation.
 */
async function clearHandicapIndex(playerId: string): Promise<void> {
  const { data, error } = await (supabase.from('players') as unknown as {
    update: (values: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      eq: (column: string, value: string) => {
        not: (column: string, operator: string, value: null) => {
          select: (columns: string) => Promise<{ data: { id: string }[] | null; error: PostgrestError | null }>;
        };
      };
    };
  })
    .update({ handicap_index: null, handicap_index_updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('id', playerId)
    .not('handicap_index', 'is', null)
    .select('id');

  if (error) {
    syncLogger.warn('Failed to clear stale player handicap index', {
      playerId: playerId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      error: error.message,
    });
    return;
  }
  if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

  syncLogger.info('Player handicap index cleared (no qualifying rounds remain)', {
    playerId: playerId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
  });
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['player', playerId] });
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['players'] });
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['auth', 'user'] });
}
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/fetchHandicapHistory.test.ts
/**
 * fetchHandicapHistory — only full scorecards count (I12, R21).
 *
 * The handicap history list and its index skip part-filled cards on both the
 * main query and the post-recalculation refresh, and the recalculation
 * candidates skip cards that can never earn a differential.
 */

type QueryResult = { data: unknown; error: unknown };

// supabase.from('scorecards') calls, in order: main query, recalc candidates,
// then (only when a recalculation succeeded) the refresh query.
const mockScorecardResults: QueryResult[] = [];
const mockScorecardSelects: string[] = [];

function mockQuery(table: string) {
  const result =
    table === 'scorecards'
      ? mockScorecardResults.shift() ?? { data: [], error: null }
      : { data: [], error: null };
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const passthrough = () => chain;
  chain.select = (columns: string) => {
    if (table === 'scorecards') mockScorecardSelects.push(columns);
    return chain;
  };
  chain.eq = passthrough;
  chain.in = passthrough;
  chain.not = passthrough;
  chain.is = passthrough;
  chain.order = passthrough;
  chain.limit = passthrough;
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockQuery(table) },
}));

const mockRecalculate = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/handicap/recalculateScorecardDifferential', () => ({
  recalculateScorecardDifferential: (...args: unknown[]) => mockRecalculate(...args),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex', () => ({
  updatePlayerHandicapIndex: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/handicap/loadCombinedAndPairs', () => ({
  fetchCombinedHandicapRounds: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve([])),
  fetchCombinableNinePairs: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve([])),
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => ({
  syncLogger: { info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() },
}));

import { fetchHandicapHistory } from '@/hooks/player/handicapHistory';

const PLAYER_ID = 'player-1';

const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

function holeScores(holeNumbers: number[] | null): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {
  return holeNumbers === null
    ? {}
    : Object.fromEntries(holeNumbers.map((n) => [String(n), { strokes: 5 }]));
}

/** A completed 18-hole history row. `null` holes = legacy `{}` card. */
function historyRow(id: string, differential: number, date: string, holeNumbers: number[] | null) {
  return {
    id,
    player_id: PLAYER_ID,
    round_id: `round-${id}`,
    total_gross: 90,
    daily_handicap_used: 18,
    handicap_differential: differential,
    course_rating_used: 72.5,
    slope_rating_used: 125,
    submitted_at: `${date}T08:00:00Z`,
    scores: holeScores(holeNumbers),
    rounds: {
      id: `round-${id}`,
      date,
      nine_type: 'full',
      game_type: 'stroke',
      team_format: null,
      courses: { id: 'course-1', name: 'Test Course', clubs: { id: 'club-1', name: 'Test Club' } },
    },
  };
}

/** A recalculation candidate row (null differential). */
function candidateRow(id: string, holeNumbers: number[] | null) {
  return { id, scores: holeScores(holeNumbers), rounds: { nine_type: 'full' } };
}

const COMPLETE = historyRow('sc-complete', 10.0, '2026-09-03', range(1, 18));
const LEGACY = historyRow('sc-legacy', 12.0, '2026-09-01', null);
const PARTIAL = historyRow('sc-partial', -38.4, '2026-09-05', range(1, 6));

function queueScorecards(...results: unknown[][]) {
  mockScorecardResults.length = 0;
  mockScorecardSelects.length = 0;
  for (const rows of results) mockScorecardResults.push({ data: rows, error: null });
}

describe('fetchHandicapHistory — full scorecards only', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockRecalculate.mockResolvedValue({ handicapDifferential: null });
  });

  it('lists complete and legacy cards (I12 lock)', async () => {
    queueScorecards([COMPLETE, LEGACY], []);

    const summary = await fetchHandicapHistory(PLAYER_ID);

    expect(summary.rounds.map((r) => r.scorecardId)).toEqual(['sc-complete', 'sc-legacy']);
    // 2 rounds → best 1: 10.0 × 0.96 = 9.6
    expect(summary.handicapIndex).toBe(9.6);
  });

  it('requests hole-by-hole scores on the main query', async () => {
    queueScorecards([], []);

    await fetchHandicapHistory(PLAYER_ID);

    expect(mockScorecardSelects[0]).toContain('scores');
  });

  it('drops a part-filled card from the history and the index', async () => {
    queueScorecards([PARTIAL, COMPLETE, LEGACY], []);

    const summary = await fetchHandicapHistory(PLAYER_ID);

    // Before the belt: sc-partial is listed and the index is −38.4 × 0.96 = −36.9
    expect(summary.rounds.map((r) => r.scorecardId)).toEqual(['sc-complete', 'sc-legacy']);
    expect(summary.handicapIndex).toBe(9.6);
  });

  it('drops a part-filled card from the refreshed list after a recalculation', async () => {
    const refreshedPartial = historyRow('sc-partial-refresh', -38.4, '2026-09-06', range(1, 6));
    queueScorecards(
      [COMPLETE],
      [candidateRow('cand-legacy-1', null)],
      [refreshedPartial, COMPLETE],
    );

    const summary = await fetchHandicapHistory(PLAYER_ID);

    expect(mockRecalculate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('cand-legacy-1');
    expect(mockScorecardSelects[2]).toContain('scores');
    expect(mockScorecardSelects[2]).toContain('game_type');
    expect(summary.rounds.map((r) => r.scorecardId)).toEqual(['sc-complete']);
  });

  it('never spends a recalculation on a card that can never earn a differential', async () => {
    queueScorecards(
      [COMPLETE],
      [candidateRow('cand-partial-2', range(1, 6)), candidateRow('cand-legacy-2', null)],
      [COMPLETE],
    );

    await fetchHandicapHistory(PLAYER_ID);

    expect(mockRecalculate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockRecalculate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('cand-legacy-2');
  });
});
```

### Task A3b: SQLite sync metadata for the fallback sync path

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/services/offline/schema/migrations.ts:125-130` (local migrations 19–21)
- Modify: `src/services/offline/types.ts:29-34` (`ScorecardRow` gains three optional columns)
- Modify: `src/services/offline/dao/ScorecardDAO.ts`:
  - `:7-8`: imports.
  - `:19-59`: `rowToScorecard` restores the metadata.
  - `:84-110`: `saveScorecard` persists it.
- Test: `src/__tests__/services/offline/database.test.ts` (new `describe` inside `describe('Scorecard Operations')`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Scorecard.syncNineType` / `syncGameType` / `syncHoles` (`src/types/index.ts:410-415`), which `submitScorecards` stamps (`src/store/scorecardStore.ts:433-436`).
- Produces:
  - SQLite `scorecards.sync_nine_type TEXT`, `sync_game_type TEXT`, `sync_holes TEXT` (JSON `Hole[]`), all nullable, in local migrations 19–21.
  - `ScorecardDAO` round-trips `syncNineType` / `syncGameType` / `syncHoles` (contract).
  - **B3a** appends `holes_played` as migration 22, after `sync_holes` in the INSERT.

**Why.** There are two sync paths:
- **The queued path** stores the whole `Scorecard` JSON in `pending_syncs`, so the stamps survive.
- **The fallback path** (`syncOrchestrator` re-reads completed, unsynced cards through `getUnsyncedScorecards` → `rowToScorecard`) drops them.

Since A3-1, `calculateHandicapData` judges completeness from `syncNineType ?? 'full'`. A **complete front-9 card** on the fallback path is therefore judged against 18 holes and loses its differential. Its daily handicap and ratings also fall back to 18-hole values (a pre-existing bug that this change fixes too).

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/combineHandicapRounds.test.ts
/**
 * Combine-two-nines validation — handicap completeness gate (I12).
 *
 * A combined 18 is handicap-eligible only when each nine is fully scored for
 * its own nine. The current combined differential is locked first.
 */

// supabase.from(table) → a chain whose first .eq(column, value) picks the row
// mockRows[table][value]; .single() resolves it (or a not-found error).
const mockRows: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};

function mockQuery(table: string) {
  let key: string | undefined;
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  chain.select = () => chain;
  chain.eq = (_column: string, value: string) => {
    if (key === undefined) key = value;
    return chain;
  };
  chain.single = () => {
    const row = key === undefined ? undefined : mockRows[table]?.[key];
    return Promise.resolve(
      row ? { data: row, error: null } : { data: null, error: { message: 'not found' } },
    );
  };
  // round_players (per-player tee override): none
  chain.maybeSingle = () => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockQuery(table) },
}));

jest.mock('@/services/queryClient', () => ({
  invalidateHandicapCache: jest.fn(),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex', () => ({
  updatePlayerHandicapIndex: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => ({
  syncLogger: { info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() },
}));

import { previewCombinedDifferential } from '@/services/handicap/combineHandicapRounds';

const PLAYER_ID = 'player-1';
const TEE_ID = 'tee-1';

/** 18 × par 4, stroke indexes 1..18 in hole order. */
const COURSE_HOLES = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => ({
  number: i + 1,
  par: 4,
  strokeIndex: i + 1,
}));

const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

/** Five strokes on each listed hole, JSONB-keyed. */
function fivesOn(holeNumbers: number[]): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (const n of holeNumbers) scores[String(n)] = { strokes: 5 };
  return scores;
}

type Scores = Record<string, { strokes: number }> | null;

/** Seed a front9 + back9 pair on the same course and tee. Null scores = legacy card (gross 45). */
function seedPair(frontScores: Scores, backScores: Scores) {
  const grossOf = (scores: Scores) =>
    scores ? Object.values(scores).reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.strokes, 0) : 45;
  const card = (id: string, roundId: string, scores: Scores) => ({
    id,
    player_id: PLAYER_ID,
    round_id: roundId,
    total_gross: grossOf(scores),
    ga_handicap_used: null,
    status: 'completed',
    scores,
  });
  const round = (id: string, nineType: string) => ({
    id,
    course_id: 'course-1',
    nine_type: nineType,
    selected_tee: { tee_id: TEE_ID, name: 'Blue', color: 'blue' },
    courses: { holes: COURSE_HOLES },
  });

  mockRows.scorecards = {
    'sc-front': card('sc-front', 'round-front', frontScores),
    'sc-back': card('sc-back', 'round-back', backScores),
  };
  mockRows.rounds = {
    'round-front': round('round-front', 'front9'),
    'round-back': round('round-back', 'back9'),
  };
  mockRows.tees = {
    [TEE_ID]: { id: TEE_ID, name: 'Blue', slope: 125, course_rating: 72.5, slope_women: null, course_rating_women: null },
  };
  // No handicap → daily handicap null → 0 strokes received; every cap is par + 2 = 6.
  mockRows.players = {
    [PLAYER_ID]: { id: PLAYER_ID, gender: 'male', handicap: null },
  };
}

describe('previewCombinedDifferential — completeness gate', () => {
  it('previews a differential for two fully scored nines (I12 lock)', async () => {
    seedPair(fivesOn(range(1, 9)), fivesOn(range(10, 18)));

    const preview = await previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back');

    // Adjusted 45 + 45 = 90 (5s are under the cap of 6): (113 / 125) × (90 − 72.5) = 15.8
    expect(preview.handicapDifferential).toBe(15.8);
    expect(preview.combinedGross).toBe(90);
  });

  it('still combines legacy nines with no hole data (I12 lock)', async () => {
    seedPair(null, null);

    const preview = await previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back');

    // Raw gross 45 + 45 = 90, no cap possible → 15.8
    expect(preview.handicapDifferential).toBe(15.8);
  });

  it('rejects a pair whose back nine stopped after 6 holes', async () => {
    seedPair(fivesOn(range(1, 9)), fivesOn(range(10, 15)));

    await expect(previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Both nines must be fully scored to combine',
    );
  });

  it('rejects a pair whose front nine is part-filled', async () => {
    seedPair(fivesOn(range(1, 6)), fivesOn(range(10, 18)));

    await expect(previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Both nines must be fully scored to combine',
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/loadCombinedAndPairs.test.ts
/**
 * fetchCombinableNinePairs — handicap completeness gate (I12).
 *
 * Only a nine scored on every hole of its own nine may be offered for
 * combining; a part-filled nine is skipped so the most recent COMPLETE
 * front/back pair is offered instead.
 */

const mockResults: Record<string, { data: unknown; error: unknown }> = {};
const mockSelects: Record<string, string[]> = {};

/** Chainable + thenable stub: every filter passes through; awaiting resolves mockResults[table]. */
function mockQuery(table: string) {
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const passthrough = () => chain;
  chain.select = (columns: string) => {
    mockSelects[table] = [...(mockSelects[table] ?? []), columns];
    return chain;
  };
  chain.eq = passthrough;
  chain.in = passthrough;
  chain.is = passthrough;
  chain.order = passthrough;
  chain.limit = passthrough;
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(mockResults[table] ?? { data: [], error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockQuery(table) },
}));

import { fetchCombinableNinePairs } from '@/services/handicap/loadCombinedAndPairs';

const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

/** A completed 9-hole scorecard row as the query returns it. `null` holes = legacy card. */
function nineRow(
  id: string,
  nineType: 'front9' | 'back9',
  holeNumbers: number[] | null,
  submittedAt: string,
) {
  return {
    id,
    round_id: `round-${id}`,
    total_gross: 45,
    daily_handicap_used: 10,
    handicap_differential: null,
    course_rating_used: 36,
    slope_rating_used: 125,
    submitted_at: submittedAt,
    scores:
      holeNumbers === null
        ? null
        : Object.fromEntries(holeNumbers.map((n) => [String(n), { strokes: 5 }])),
    rounds: {
      id: `round-${id}`,
      date: submittedAt.slice(0, 10),
      nine_type: nineType,
      selected_tee: { name: 'Blue' },
      courses: { id: 'course-1', name: 'Test Course', clubs: { id: 'club-1', name: 'Test Club' } },
    },
  };
}

/** Rows in the query's order (submitted_at desc). */
function seedScorecards(rows: ReturnType<typeof nineRow>[]) {
  mockResults.handicap_combined_rounds = { data: [], error: null };
  mockResults.scorecards = { data: rows, error: null };
  mockSelects.scorecards = [];
}

describe('fetchCombinableNinePairs — completeness gate', () => {
  it('pairs the most recent complete front and back nines (I12 lock)', async () => {
    seedScorecards([
      nineRow('b1', 'back9', range(10, 18), '2026-09-10T08:00:00Z'),
      nineRow('f1', 'front9', range(1, 9), '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z'),
    ]);

    const pairs = await fetchCombinableNinePairs('player-1');

    expect(pairs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(pairs[0].front.scorecardId).toBe('f1');
    expect(pairs[0].back.scorecardId).toBe('b1');
    // Projected: CR 36 + 36 = 72, slope (125 + 125) / 2 = 125, gross 90:
    // (113 / 125) × (90 − 72) = 16.27 → 16.3
    expect(pairs[0].projectedDifferential).toBe(16.3);
  });

  it('keeps legacy nines with no hole data combinable (I12 lock)', async () => {
    seedScorecards([
      nineRow('b-legacy', 'back9', null, '2026-09-10T08:00:00Z'),
      nineRow('f-legacy', 'front9', null, '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z'),
    ]);

    const pairs = await fetchCombinableNinePairs('player-1');

    expect(pairs).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('requests hole-by-hole scores', async () => {
    seedScorecards([]);

    await fetchCombinableNinePairs('player-1');

    expect(mockSelects.scorecards[0]).toContain('scores');
  });

  it('skips a part-filled nine and pairs the latest complete one', async () => {
    seedScorecards([
      nineRow('b-partial', 'back9', range(10, 15), '2026-09-12T08:00:00Z'),
      nineRow('b-full', 'back9', range(10, 18), '2026-09-10T08:00:00Z'),
      nineRow('f1', 'front9', range(1, 9), '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z'),
    ]);

    const pairs = await fetchCombinableNinePairs('player-1');

    expect(pairs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(pairs[0].back.scorecardId).toBe('b-full');
  });
```
