```tsx
// src/__tests__/hooks/scorecard/useQuickScoreSubmit.test.tsx
/**
 * useQuickScoreSubmit — the handicap snapshot Quick Score Entry persists.
 *
 * Locks today's snapshot first, then covers the completeness gate (I12): a
 * part-filled card gets no differential, judged against the round's nineType
 * (never the hole list, which the Quick Score caller passes unfiltered).
 */
import React from 'react';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useQuickScoreSubmit, type QuickScoreSubmitInput } from '@/hooks/scorecard/useQuickScoreSubmit';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { TeeBox } from '@/types/database.types';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
const mockGetCurrentUser = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
  getCurrentUser: () => mockGetCurrentUser(),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/rounds/refinalizeRoundResults', () => ({
  refinalizeRoundResults: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));

type QueryResult = { data?: unknown; error?: unknown; count?: number | null };
let upsertPayloads: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];

/** Chainable + thenable stub that records upsert payloads. */
function queryStub(result: QueryResult) {
  const settled = { data: null, error: null, ...result };
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const passthrough = () => chain;
  chain.select = passthrough;
  chain.eq = passthrough;
  chain.update = passthrough;
  chain.upsert = (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    upsertPayloads.push(payload);
    return chain;
  };
  chain.single = () => Promise.resolve(settled);
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(settled).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

/** upsert → round lookup → player count (2) → completed count (1): the round stays open. */
function scriptSupabase() {
  const queue: Record<string, QueryResult[]> = {
    scorecards: [{ data: { id: 'scorecard-1' } }, { count: 1 }],
    rounds: [{ data: { status: 'in-progress', competition_id: null } }],
    round_players: [{ count: 2 }],
  };
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) => queryStub(queue[table]?.shift() ?? {}));
}

function makeWrapper() {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { mutations: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

// create18Holes: pars 4,3,5,4,4,3,4,5,4 | 4,3,5,4,4,3,4,5,4 → par 36 + 36 = 72.
const HOLES = create18Holes();
const TEE: TeeBox = { name: 'Blue', color: 'blue', courseRating: 72.5, slopeRating: 125 };

const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

/** One over par on each listed hole, in the DB format quick entry submits. */
function bogeyScores(holeNumbers: number[]): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (const n of holeNumbers) scores[String(n)] = { strokes: HOLES[n - 1].par + 1 };
  return scores;
}

const grossOf = (scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }>) =>
  Object.values(scores).reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.strokes, 0);

function makeInput(overrides: Partial<QuickScoreSubmitInput> = {}): QuickScoreSubmitInput {
  const scores = overrides.scores ?? bogeyScores(range(1, 18));
  return {
    roundId: 'round-1',
    playerId: 'player-1',
    scores,
    totalGross: grossOf(scores),
    totalNet: 0,
    totalPoints: 0,
    player: { id: 'player-1', name: 'Sam', handicap: 18, gender: 'male' },
    selectedTee: TEE,
    // As the Quick Score caller passes them: the whole course, unfiltered.
    holes: HOLES,
    nineType: 'full',
    handicapSource: 'profile',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

async function submit(input: QuickScoreSubmitInput): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  scriptSupabase();
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useQuickScoreSubmit(), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });
  await act(async () => {
    await result.current.mutateAsync(input);
  });
  return upsertPayloads[upsertPayloads.length - 1];
}

describe('useQuickScoreSubmit — handicap snapshot', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    upsertPayloads = [];
    mockGetCurrentUser.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'user-1' });
  });

  it('snapshots a complete 18-hole card (I12 lock)', async () => {
    const payload = await submit(makeInput());

    // DHC: ((18 × 125 / 113) + (72.5 − 72)) × 0.93 × 0.9986 = 18.96 → 19
    expect(payload).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({
        total_gross: 90,
        ga_handicap_used: 18,
        daily_handicap_used: 19,
        course_rating_used: 72.5,
        slope_rating_used: 125,
        // (113 / 125) × (90 − 72.5) = 15.8
        handicap_differential: 15.8,
      }),
    );
  });

  it('snapshots a complete back-9 card (I12 lock)', async () => {
    const scores = bogeyScores(range(10, 18));

    const payload = await submit(makeInput({ scores, totalGross: grossOf(scores), nineType: 'back9' }));

    expect(payload.handicap_differential).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('writes no differential for an 18-hole card scored on only 6 holes', async () => {
    const scores = bogeyScores(range(1, 6));

    const payload = await submit(makeInput({ scores, totalGross: grossOf(scores) }));

    // Before the gate: gross 23 + 6 = 29 → (113 / 125) × (29 − 72.5) = −39.3
    expect(payload.handicap_differential).toBeNull();
    // The rest of the snapshot is unchanged.
    expect(payload.daily_handicap_used).toBe(19);
    expect(payload.course_rating_used).toBe(72.5);
  });

  it('writes no differential for a back-9 round scored on holes 10–15 only', async () => {
    const scores = bogeyScores(range(10, 15));

    const payload = await submit(makeInput({ scores, totalGross: grossOf(scores), nineType: 'back9' }));

    expect(payload.handicap_differential).toBeNull();
  });

  it('writes no differential when the card covers only 9 holes of an 18-hole round', async () => {
    const scores = bogeyScores(range(1, 9));

    const payload = await submit(makeInput({ scores, totalGross: grossOf(scores), nineType: 'full' }));

    expect(payload.handicap_differential).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
    handicap_source: 'profile',
    competition: null,
  };
}

type HookResult = { current: ReturnType<typeof useQuickScoreEntry> };

/** Tap "+" until each listed hole reads one over par. */
function scoreBogeys(result: HookResult, holeNumbers: number[]) {
  act(() => {
    for (const n of holeNumbers) {
      for (let i = 0; i < HOLES[n - 1].par + 1; i++) result.current.incrementScore(n);
    }
  });
}

function renderEntry(): HookResult {
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useQuickScoreEntry({ roundId: 'round-1', playerId: 'player-1' }));
  return result;
}

    expect(result.current.totals.totalGross).toBe(90);

    expect(result.current.handicapDifferential).toBeNull();

      await result.current.handleConfirmSave();
    });

    expect(mockMutateAsync).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ nineType: 'front9' }));
  });
});
```

```ts
        player,
        selectedTee,
        holes: allHoles,
        // The round's planned nine — the submit's completeness gate (I12)
        // judges the card against it.
        nineType,
        handicapSource,
      });
      setShowReview(false);
      navigation.goBack();
    } catch (error) {
      setShowReview(false);
      showAlert('Error', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to save scores');
    }
  }, [player, scores, roundId, playerId, totals, selectedTee, allHoles, nineType, handicapSource, submitMutation, navigation]);
```

```tsx
// src/screens/leagues/__tests__/useLeagueQuickAddRound.test.tsx
/**
 * useLeagueQuickAddRound — league rounds need a complete 18 (I12).
 *
 * A partial card must be stopped at review, before handleConfirmSave creates
 * the round and scorecard (today it reached a misleading "missing rating"
 * error only after both rows were written), and the preview must not show a
 * differential for it. A course with fewer than 18 holes is rejected at
 * selection — it could never produce a complete league card.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useLeagueQuickAddRound } from '../LeagueQuickAddRoundScreen/useLeagueQuickAddRound';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';

const mockShowAlert = jest.fn();
const mockMutateAsync = jest.fn();
const mockFrom = jest.fn();
const mockGetCurrentUser = jest.fn();

jest.mock('@react-navigation/native', () => ({
  useNavigation: () => ({ goBack: jest.fn() }),
}));

jest.mock('@/hooks/useConfirmationDialog', () => ({
  useConfirmationDialog: () => ({ showAlert: mockShowAlert, dialogConfig: null, dismissDialog: jest.fn() }),
}));

jest.mock('@/hooks/useLeagues', () => ({
  useLeaguePlayers: () => ({ data: [] }),
}));

jest.mock('@/hooks/scorecard/useQuickScoreSubmit', () => ({
  useQuickScoreSubmit: () => ({ mutateAsync: mockMutateAsync, isPending: false }),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
  getCurrentUser: () => mockGetCurrentUser(),
}));

// create18Holes: par 72.
const HOLES = create18Holes();
const TEE = { name: 'Blue', color: 'blue', courseRating: 72.5, slopeRating: 125 };
const PLAYER = { id: 'player-1', name: 'Sam', handicap: 18, gender: 'male' as const };
const INCOMPLETE_MESSAGE = 'Enter a score for all 18 holes to add this round to a league.';
const SHORT_COURSE_MESSAGE = 'League rounds need an 18-hole course. Please select a different course.';

const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

function makeWrapper() {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

type HookResult = { current: ReturnType<typeof useLeagueQuickAddRound> };

function renderWizard(): HookResult {
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useLeagueQuickAddRound({ leagueId: 'league-1' }), {
    wrapper: makeWrapper(),
  });
  act(() => result.current.handleSelectPlayer(PLAYER));
  return result;
}

/** Walk the wizard to the score-entry step on the 18-hole course. */
function renderAtScoreEntry(): HookResult {
  const result = renderWizard();
  act(() =>
    result.current.handleSelectCourse({
      courseId: 'course-1',
      courseName: 'Test Course',
      clubName: 'Test Club',
      holes: HOLES,
      tees: [TEE],
    }),
  );
  act(() => result.current.handleSelectTee(TEE));
  return result;
}

/** Tap "+" until each listed hole reads one over par. */
function scoreBogeys(result: HookResult, holeNumbers: number[]) {
  act(() => {
    for (const n of holeNumbers) {
      for (let i = 0; i < HOLES[n - 1].par + 1; i++) result.current.incrementScore(n);
    }
  });
}

describe('useLeagueQuickAddRound — complete 18 required', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('accepts an 18-hole course (I12 lock)', () => {
    const result = renderAtScoreEntry();

    expect(result.current.step).toBe('scores');
    expect(mockShowAlert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reaches review with a complete card and previews its differential (I12 lock)', () => {
    const result = renderAtScoreEntry();
    scoreBogeys(result, range(1, 18));

    act(() => result.current.handleGoToReview());

    expect(result.current.step).toBe('review');
    // (113 / 125) × (90 − 72.5) = 15.8
    expect(result.current.handicapDifferential).toBe(15.8);
    expect(mockShowAlert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects a course with fewer than 18 holes', () => {
    const result = renderWizard();

    act(() =>
      result.current.handleSelectCourse({
        courseId: 'course-9',
        courseName: 'Nine Hole Course',
        clubName: 'Test Club',
        holes: HOLES.slice(0, 9),
        tees: [TEE],
      }),
    );

    expect(result.current.step).toBe('course');
    expect(result.current.selectedCourse).toBeNull();
    expect(mockShowAlert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Course Not Eligible', SHORT_COURSE_MESSAGE);
  });

  it('blocks review until all 18 holes are scored', () => {
    const result = renderAtScoreEntry();
    scoreBogeys(result, range(1, 6));

    act(() => result.current.handleGoToReview());

    expect(result.current.step).toBe('scores');
    expect(mockShowAlert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Incomplete Round', INCOMPLETE_MESSAGE);
  });

  it('previews no differential for a part-filled card', () => {
    const result = renderAtScoreEntry();
    scoreBogeys(result, range(1, 6));

    // Before the gate: gross 29 → (113 / 125) × (29 − 72.5) = −39.3
    expect(result.current.handicapDifferential).toBeNull();
  });

  it('never writes a round or scorecard for a part-filled card on save', async () => {
    const result = renderAtScoreEntry();
    scoreBogeys(result, range(1, 6));

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.handleConfirmSave();
    });

    expect(mockGetCurrentUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockFrom).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockMutateAsync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockShowAlert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Incomplete Round', INCOMPLETE_MESSAGE);
  });
});
```

### Task A7: Server guard + data fix — only full scorecards count (R13, R21)

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql`
- Create: `supabase/scripts/full_scorecards_only_report.sql`
- Create: `supabase/tests/full_scorecards_only_handicap.verify.sql`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the client predicate `isCompleteForHandicap` (A3-1), which the SQL mirrors rule for rule.
- Produces (all in `public`):
  - `scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(p_scores JSONB, p_nine_type TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN`, `IMMUTABLE` (contract). The rules:
    - `NULL`, a JSON `null`, a non-object or `{}` ⇒ `TRUE` (no per-hole data: legacy, or multi-ball, whose server `scores` is `{}`);
    - otherwise, every hole in 1–18 / 1–9 (`front9`) / 10–18 (`back9`) must have strokes > 0;
    - accepted hole shapes: a JSON number, `{"strokes": n}`, or multi-ball `{"balls": [...]}` where any ball qualifies;
    - strokes stored as a string don't count (the same as the client).
  - `scorecard_hole_has_strokes(p_hole JSONB) RETURNS BOOLEAN`, `IMMUTABLE`: the per-hole helper.
  - `scorecard_eligible_for_differential(p_round_id UUID, p_scores JSONB) RETURNS BOOLEAN`, `STABLE`. It is **the single extension point**: B1a `CREATE OR REPLACE`s it to add `rounds.holes_played IS NULL`.
  - Trigger `scorecards_full_card_differential` (`BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE` on `scorecards`) calls function `scorecards_full_card_differential()`.
  - Trigger `handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards` (`BEFORE INSERT` on `handicap_combined_rounds`) calls function `handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards()`. It raises `'Both nines must be fully scored to combine'` with `ERRCODE 22023`, the same message as A4a's client check.
  - Table `handicap_full_card_fix_audit` records the one-off data fix.

**The server `scores` shape** (verified at planning):
- `scorecardSync.ts:136-171` (`scoresForDb`) writes `{"<hole>": {"strokes": n, "putts": …, …}}` for single-ball holes only. String keys; `strokes` is a JSON number; a pickup is `strokes: 10`; did-not-attempt is `strokes: 0`.
- Multi-ball holes are skipped, so a multi-ball card is `{}` on the server.
- `write_scorecard_snapshot` (`20260714000000_scorecard_optimistic_concurrency.sql:50-110`) stores `p_snapshot->'scores'` verbatim (`COALESCE(…, '{}')`) and writes `handicap_differential` in the same INSERT/UPDATE. So the BEFORE trigger sees the new `scores` and the new differential together.
- Quick Score (`useQuickScoreSubmit`) upserts `{"<hole>": {"strokes": n}}`.
- `scorecards.scores` is `JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'` (`20250109000000_mvp_phase_1_schema.sql:176`).

The `handicap_combined_rounds` schema is in `20260514000000_handicap_combined_rounds.sql`: `front_scorecard_id` / `back_scorecard_id` are FKs to `scorecards`, `course_id` is NOT NULL, and `combined_gross` must be > 0.

**Old clients.** They recalculate a completed card's NULL differential when Home opens (`handicapHistory.ts:63-70, 139-143` → `recalculateScorecardDifferential` → `updatePlayerHandicapIndex`). The trigger nulls whatever they write for an incomplete card, and they then recompute the index without it.

`supabase/tests/full_scorecards_only_handicap.verify.sql`:

```sql
-- =====================================================
-- Full-scorecards-only handicap (R21) - verification script
-- =====================================================
-- Run AFTER applying 20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql:
--   psql "$LOCAL_DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/tests/full_scorecards_only_handicap.verify.sql
-- Every assertion runs inside BEGIN … ROLLBACK, so the DB stays clean.
-- Runs as the migration owner (postgres), so RLS does not apply; the
-- triggers are SECURITY DEFINER, so they behave the same for app users.
-- =====================================================

BEGIN;

-- ---- Fixtures --------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email)
  VALUES ('fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'full-card-verify@example.com');

INSERT INTO players (id, name, email)
  VALUES ('fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Full Card Verify', 'full-card-verify@example.com');

INSERT INTO clubs (id, source, name)
  VALUES ('fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1', 'manual', 'Verify Club');

INSERT INTO courses (id, club_id, name)
  VALUES ('fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2',
          'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1',
          'Verify Course');

-- One round per card (scorecards are unique per round + player).
INSERT INTO rounds (id, course_id, user_id, status, nine_type) VALUES
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'in-progress', 'full'),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000002', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'in-progress', 'full'),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000003', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'in-progress', 'full'),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000004', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'in-progress', 'front9'),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000005', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'in-progress', 'back9'),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000006', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'in-progress', 'back9'),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000008', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c2', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'in-progress', 'full');

DO $$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'Fixtures seeded'; END $$;

-- ---- Test 1: the predicate mirrors isCompleteForHandicap -------------
DO $$
DECLARE
  full18 JSONB := (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(1, 18) n);
  front9 JSONB := (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(1, 9) n);
  back9  JSONB := (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(10, 18) n);
  six    JSONB := (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(1, 6) n);
  back6  JSONB := (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(10, 15) n);
  bare9  JSONB := (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, to_jsonb(5)) FROM generate_series(1, 9) n);
BEGIN
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(NULL, 'full'), 'T1a: NULL scores are legacy (complete)';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap('{}'::JSONB, 'full'), 'T1b: {} is legacy (complete)';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap('{}'::JSONB, 'back9'), 'T1c: {} is legacy for a back 9';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap('null'::JSONB, 'full'), 'T1d: JSON null is legacy';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(full18, 'full'), 'T1e: 18 scored holes are complete';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(full18 - '18', 'full'), 'T1f: 17 of 18 is incomplete';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(six, 'full'), 'T1g: 6 of 18 is incomplete';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(front9, 'front9'), 'T1h: front 9 judged on 1-9';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(back9, 'back9'), 'T1i: back 9 judged on 10-18';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(back6, 'back9'), 'T1j: back 9 ended after 6 (10-15)';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(front9, 'back9'), 'T1k: back 9 scored on 1-9 is incomplete';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(front9, 'full'), 'T1l: nine type decides, not the scores';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(front9 || '{"10": {"strokes": 4}}'::JSONB, 'front9'), 'T1m: holes outside the nine are ignored';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(full18 || '{"7": {"strokes": 10}}'::JSONB, 'full'), 'T1n: a pickup (10) counts';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(full18 || '{"7": {"strokes": 0}}'::JSONB, 'full'), 'T1o: strokes 0 is unscored';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(full18 || '{"7": null}'::JSONB, 'full'), 'T1p: a null hole is unscored';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(front9 || '{"4": {"strokes": "5"}}'::JSONB, 'front9'), 'T1q: string strokes do not count';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(bare9, 'front9'), 'T1r: bare numbers count';
  ASSERT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(front9 || '{"3": {"balls": [{"strokes": 0}, {"strokes": 5}]}}'::JSONB, 'front9'), 'T1s: multi-ball, any ball scored';
  ASSERT NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(front9 || '{"3": {"balls": [{"strokes": 0}, {"strokes": 0}]}}'::JSONB, 'front9'), 'T1t: multi-ball, no ball scored';
  RAISE NOTICE 'Test 1 PASSED: predicate mirrors isCompleteForHandicap';
END $$;

-- ---- Cards -----------------------------------------------------------
-- C1 complete 18, C2 six of 18, C3 legacy {}, C4 complete front 9,
-- C5 complete back 9, C6 back 9 holes 10-15, C8 multi-ball 18 (any ball).
INSERT INTO scorecards (id, round_id, player_id, status, scores, total_gross, handicap_differential) VALUES
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000001', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'completed',
   (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(1, 18) n), 90, 15.8),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000002', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'completed',
   (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(1, 6) n), 30, -38.4),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000003', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000003', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'completed',
   '{}'::JSONB, 90, 17.6),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000004', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000004', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'completed',
   (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(1, 9) n), 45, 8.0),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000005', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000005', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'completed',
   (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(10, 18) n), 45, 8.0),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000006', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000006', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'completed',
   (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)) FROM generate_series(10, 15) n), 30, -20.0),
  ('fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000008', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000008', 'fc000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'completed',
   (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n::TEXT, jsonb_build_object('balls', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('strokes', 0), jsonb_build_object('strokes', 5)))) FROM generate_series(1, 18) n), 90, 15.8);

-- ---- Test 2: the scorecards trigger on INSERT ------------------------
DO $$
DECLARE
  d1 NUMERIC; d2 NUMERIC; d3 NUMERIC; d4 NUMERIC; d6 NUMERIC; d8 NUMERIC;
BEGIN
  SELECT handicap_differential INTO d1 FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000001';
  SELECT handicap_differential INTO d2 FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002';
  SELECT handicap_differential INTO d3 FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000003';
  SELECT handicap_differential INTO d4 FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000004';
  SELECT handicap_differential INTO d6 FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000006';
  SELECT handicap_differential INTO d8 FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000008';
  ASSERT d1 = 15.8, 'T2a FAILED: a complete 18 keeps its differential';
  ASSERT d2 IS NULL, 'T2b FAILED: a 6-of-18 card must get a NULL differential';
  ASSERT d3 = 17.6, 'T2c FAILED: a legacy {} card keeps its differential';
  ASSERT d4 = 8.0, 'T2d FAILED: a complete front 9 is judged on its own nine (rounds.nine_type)';
  ASSERT d6 IS NULL, 'T2e FAILED: a back 9 scored on 10-15 must get a NULL differential';
  ASSERT d8 = 15.8, 'T2f FAILED: a multi-ball card with every hole scored keeps its differential';
  RAISE NOTICE 'Test 2 PASSED: INSERT nulls only incomplete cards';

-- ---- Test 3: UPDATE that removes a hole nulls the differential -------
UPDATE scorecards
   SET scores = scores - '18'
 WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000001';

BEGIN

  ASSERT d IS NULL, 'T3 FAILED: removing hole 18 must null the differential';

END $$;

BEGIN
  SELECT handicap_differential INTO d FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002';
  ASSERT d IS NULL, 'T4 FAILED: an old-client recalculation must not resurrect the differential';
  RAISE NOTICE 'Test 4 PASSED: old-client recalculation is neutralised';
END $$;

       total_gross = 90,

 WHERE id = 'fc000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000002';

BEGIN

  ASSERT d = 15.8, 'T5 FAILED: a card completed in the same write keeps its differential';

END $$;

      75, 2.3, 72.5, 125, now()
    );

END $$;
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the migration**

`supabase/migrations/20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql`:

```sql
-- Only full scorecards count toward the handicap (R13, R21)
--
-- "Only full scorecards should contribute to the social index/handicap.
--  Part-filled quick score rounds should definitely not contribute." — Sam
--
-- The client gate (isCompleteForHandicap, src/utils/handicapEligibility.ts)
-- stops new app versions writing a differential for an incomplete card. Old
-- versions (1.14.x and earlier) still compute one — on submit, and
-- retroactively for any completed card with a NULL differential whenever Home
-- opens (handicapHistory.ts → recalculateScorecardDifferential →
-- updatePlayerHandicapIndex). This migration enforces the rule on the server
-- so no client version can put an incomplete card into the index:
--
--   1. scorecard_hole_has_strokes / scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap —
--      IMMUTABLE mirror of isCompleteForHandicap. Keep the two in step.
--   2. scorecard_eligible_for_differential(round_id, scores) — the single
--      eligibility decision both triggers share. The end-round-early migration
--      (20261007000200) CREATE OR REPLACEs it to add rounds.holes_played.
--   3. Trigger scorecards_full_card_differential (BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON
--      scorecards): handicap_differential := NULL for an incomplete card.
--   4. Trigger handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards (BEFORE INSERT ON
--      handicap_combined_rounds): rejects a pair with an incomplete nine.
--   5. One-off data fix: records (handicap_full_card_fix_audit) and then
--      nulls the differential of every existing incomplete card.
--
-- Deliberately NOT done here (R21):
--   * players.handicap_index is not recomputed in SQL. Every app version
--     recomputes it on the next Home / handicap-history load
--     (fetchHandicapHistory → updatePlayerHandicapIndex).
--   * Existing handicap_combined_rounds / league_rounds rows built from an
--     incomplete card are listed by supabase/scripts/full_scorecards_only_report.sql
--     for review, not deleted.
--
-- Side effects of the data fix: the nulled rows' updated_at is bumped by
-- update_scorecards_updated_at (as in 20260629000000). No notification
-- trigger fires — they only react to a status change.
--
-- Apply: psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -f <this file>

-- =====================================================
-- 1. Completeness predicate (mirror of isCompleteForHandicap)
-- =====================================================

-- One stored hole score carries a stroke count: a JSON number > 0,
-- {"strokes": n > 0}, or multi-ball {"balls": [...]} with any ball scored.
-- A pickup is strokes 10 (counts); did-not-attempt is strokes 0 (does not).
-- CASE (not AND/OR) keeps every ::NUMERIC cast behind its jsonb_typeof check.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scorecard_hole_has_strokes(p_hole JSONB)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
PARALLEL SAFE
AS $$
  SELECT CASE jsonb_typeof(p_hole)
    WHEN 'number' THEN (p_hole #>> '{}')::NUMERIC > 0
    WHEN 'object' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_hole -> 'balls') = 'array' THEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_hole -> 'balls') AS b(ball)
           WHERE CASE jsonb_typeof(b.ball)
                   WHEN 'number' THEN (b.ball #>> '{}')::NUMERIC > 0
                   WHEN 'object' THEN
                     CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.ball -> 'strokes') = 'number'
                          THEN (b.ball ->> 'strokes')::NUMERIC > 0
                          ELSE FALSE
                     END
                   ELSE FALSE
                 END
        )
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_hole -> 'strokes') = 'number'
          THEN (p_hole ->> 'strokes')::NUMERIC > 0
        ELSE FALSE
      END
    ELSE FALSE
  END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.scorecard_hole_has_strokes(JSONB) IS
  'True when one scorecards.scores hole entry carries strokes > 0 (number, {strokes}, or multi-ball {balls} with any ball scored). Helper for scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap.';

-- A card is complete for handicap when every planned hole of its nine type
-- has strokes. No per-hole data at all (NULL, JSON null, non-object, {}) is a
-- legacy / multi-ball card and keeps the old gross-only rule (TRUE).
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(
  p_scores JSONB,
  p_nine_type TEXT
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
PARALLEL SAFE
AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_scores IS NULL
      OR jsonb_typeof(p_scores) <> 'object'
      OR p_scores = '{}'::JSONB
      THEN TRUE
    ELSE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM generate_series(
               CASE p_nine_type WHEN 'back9' THEN 10 ELSE 1 END,
               CASE p_nine_type WHEN 'front9' THEN 9 ELSE 18 END
             ) AS h(hole)
       WHERE NOT public.scorecard_hole_has_strokes(p_scores -> h.hole::TEXT)
    )
  END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(JSONB, TEXT) IS
  'Server mirror of isCompleteForHandicap (src/utils/handicapEligibility.ts): every hole of the nine type (full 1-18, front9 1-9, back9 10-18) has strokes > 0; no per-hole data ({} / NULL) counts as complete (legacy rule).';

-- =====================================================
-- 2. Shared eligibility decision (extension point)
-- =====================================================

-- Whether a card on this round may carry a handicap differential.
-- 20261007000200_end_round_early.sql replaces this to also require
-- rounds.holes_played IS NULL — both triggers pick that up unchanged.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(
  p_round_id UUID,
  p_scores JSONB
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_nine_type TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT r.nine_type INTO v_nine_type FROM rounds r WHERE r.id = p_round_id;
  RETURN public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(p_scores, COALESCE(v_nine_type, 'full'));
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(UUID, JSONB) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(UUID, JSONB) IS
  'Single handicap-eligibility decision used by the scorecards_full_card_differential and handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards triggers. Replace this function (not the triggers) to add a rule.';

-- =====================================================
-- 3. scorecards: incomplete cards never keep a differential
-- =====================================================

-- SECURITY DEFINER so the rounds lookup is never hidden by RLS (a missed
-- lookup would judge a 9-hole card against 18 holes).
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scorecards_full_card_differential()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.handicap_differential IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(NEW.round_id, NEW.scores) THEN
    NEW.handicap_differential := NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.scorecards_full_card_differential() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS scorecards_full_card_differential ON public.scorecards;
CREATE TRIGGER scorecards_full_card_differential
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.scorecards
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.scorecards_full_card_differential();

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.scorecards_full_card_differential() IS
  'BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE on scorecards: forces handicap_differential to NULL when scorecard_eligible_for_differential is false (incomplete card). Neutralises old clients that still compute one.';

-- =====================================================
-- 4. handicap_combined_rounds: both nines must be complete
-- =====================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_front_round UUID;
  v_front_scores JSONB;
  v_back_round UUID;
  v_back_scores JSONB;
BEGIN
  SELECT s.round_id, s.scores INTO v_front_round, v_front_scores
    FROM scorecards s WHERE s.id = NEW.front_scorecard_id;
  SELECT s.round_id, s.scores INTO v_back_round, v_back_scores
    FROM scorecards s WHERE s.id = NEW.back_scorecard_id;

  -- A missing card is left to the foreign keys to report.
  IF v_front_round IS NULL OR v_back_round IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(v_front_round, v_front_scores)
     OR NOT public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(v_back_round, v_back_scores) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Both nines must be fully scored to combine'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards ON public.handicap_combined_rounds;
CREATE TRIGGER handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards
  BEFORE INSERT ON public.handicap_combined_rounds
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards();

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards() IS
  'BEFORE INSERT on handicap_combined_rounds: rejects (22023) a pair when either source card is not eligible for a differential (scorecard_eligible_for_differential).';

-- =====================================================
-- 5. One-off data fix (audited)
-- =====================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit (
  scorecard_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,           -- no FK: the audit outlives deleted cards
  player_id UUID NOT NULL,
  round_id UUID NOT NULL,
  nine_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  scorecard_status TEXT,
  old_differential NUMERIC(4,1) NOT NULL,
  fixed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

COMMENT ON TABLE public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit IS
  'Scorecards whose handicap_differential was nulled by 20261007000100 because the card was incomplete for its nine type. Read by supabase/scripts/full_scorecards_only_report.sql. Not exposed to app users.';

ALTER TABLE public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit FROM anon, authenticated;

-- 5a. Record every incomplete card that still carries a differential.
INSERT INTO public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit
  (scorecard_id, player_id, round_id, nine_type, scorecard_status, old_differential)
SELECT s.id, s.player_id, s.round_id, COALESCE(r.nine_type, 'full'), s.status, s.handicap_differential
  FROM public.scorecards s
  JOIN public.rounds r ON r.id = s.round_id
 WHERE s.handicap_differential IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(s.scores, COALESCE(r.nine_type, 'full'))
ON CONFLICT (scorecard_id) DO NOTHING;

-- 5b. Null them. (The BEFORE trigger above would null them anyway.)
UPDATE public.scorecards s
   SET handicap_differential = NULL
  FROM public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit a
 WHERE a.scorecard_id = s.id
   AND s.handicap_differential IS NOT NULL;
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the rollout report script**

`supabase/scripts/full_scorecards_only_report.sql`:

```sql
-- =====================================================
-- Full-scorecards-only handicap (R21) — rollout report
-- =====================================================
-- Read-only. Requires 20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql.
--
-- DRY RUN before applying (see the impact, change nothing):
--   psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
--   BEGIN;
--   \i supabase/migrations/20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql
--   \i supabase/scripts/full_scorecards_only_report.sql
--   ROLLBACK;
--   SQL
--
-- AFTER applying (verify, then re-run days later to watch indexes settle):
--   psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/scripts/full_scorecards_only_report.sql
--
-- Section 3's "stored" index only changes once each player's app recomputes
-- it (next Home / handicap-history load), so a large delta right after the
-- migration is expected; it should shrink to ~0 as players open the app.
-- =====================================================

\echo '== 1. Cards whose differential the data fix removed (before → after) =='
SELECT COUNT(*)                                                     AS cards_fixed,
       COUNT(DISTINCT player_id)                                    AS players_affected,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nine_type = 'full')                   AS eighteen_hole_cards,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nine_type <> 'full')                  AS nine_hole_cards,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE scorecard_status IN ('completed', 'confirmed')) AS completed_cards,
       MIN(old_differential)                                        AS lowest_removed_differential
  FROM public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit;

\echo '== 2. Incomplete cards still carrying a differential (expected 0) =='
SELECT COUNT(*)                  AS incomplete_cards_with_differential,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.player_id) AS players
  FROM public.scorecards s
  JOIN public.rounds r ON r.id = s.round_id
 WHERE s.handicap_differential IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(s.scores, COALESCE(r.nine_type, 'full'));

-- Projected index for every affected player, mirroring
-- updatePlayerHandicapIndex + calculateHandicapIndex: the 20 most recent
-- eligible 18-hole differentials plus 20 most recent combined rounds, merged,
-- most recent 20, best-X-of-N (WHS table), × 0.96, capped at 54, 1 decimal.
CREATE TEMP VIEW _full_card_index_projection AS
WITH affected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit
),
card_diffs AS (
  SELECT s.player_id,
         s.handicap_differential AS differential,
         COALESCE(s.submitted_at, r.date::TIMESTAMPTZ) AS effective_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.player_id
           ORDER BY COALESCE(s.submitted_at, r.date::TIMESTAMPTZ) DESC
         ) AS rn
    FROM public.scorecards s
    JOIN public.rounds r ON r.id = s.round_id
   WHERE s.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM affected)
     AND s.status IN ('completed', 'confirmed')
     AND s.handicap_differential IS NOT NULL
     AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND r.nine_type = 'full'
     AND NOT (COALESCE(r.game_type, '') IN ('scramble', 'alt-shot')
              OR COALESCE(r.team_format, '') IN ('scramble', 'alt-shot'))
     AND public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(s.scores, r.nine_type)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT hcr.player_id,
         hcr.handicap_differential AS differential,
         hcr.effective_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hcr.player_id ORDER BY hcr.effective_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM public.handicap_combined_rounds hcr
   WHERE hcr.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM affected)
),
merged AS (
  SELECT player_id, differential, effective_date FROM card_diffs WHERE rn <= 20
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, differential, effective_date FROM combined WHERE rn <= 20
),
recent20 AS (
  SELECT player_id, differential
    FROM (
      SELECT player_id, differential,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY effective_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM merged
    ) ranked
   WHERE rn <= 20
),
counts AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM recent20 GROUP BY player_id
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT player_id,
         CASE
           WHEN n <= 5  THEN 1
           WHEN n <= 8  THEN 2
           WHEN n <= 11 THEN 3
           WHEN n <= 14 THEN 4
           WHEN n <= 16 THEN 5
           WHEN n <= 18 THEN 6
           WHEN n  = 19 THEN 7
           ELSE 8
         END AS count_to_use
    FROM counts
),
best AS (
  SELECT player_id, differential,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY differential ASC) AS brn
    FROM recent20
),
index_calc AS (
  SELECT q.player_id,
         ROUND(LEAST(AVG(b.differential) * 0.96, 54.0)::NUMERIC, 1) AS projected_index
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN best b ON b.player_id = q.player_id AND b.brn <= q.count_to_use
   GROUP BY q.player_id
)
SELECT p.id                     AS player_id,
       p.name,
       p.handicap_index         AS stored_index,
       ic.projected_index,
       ic.projected_index - p.handicap_index AS delta,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.handicap_full_card_fix_audit a WHERE a.player_id = p.id) AS cards_removed,
       CASE
         WHEN ic.projected_index IS NULL AND p.handicap_index IS NOT NULL
           THEN 'projected NULL: app clears the index on next load (no qualifying rounds left)'
         WHEN ABS(ic.projected_index - p.handicap_index) > 2.0
           THEN 'moves > 2.0'
         ELSE ''
       END                      AS flag
  FROM affected a
  JOIN public.players p ON p.id = a.player_id
  LEFT JOIN index_calc ic ON ic.player_id = a.player_id;

\echo '== 3a. Affected players: index movement summary =='
SELECT COUNT(*)                                        AS players_affected,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag = 'moves > 2.0')    AS players_moving_more_than_2,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag LIKE 'projected NULL%') AS players_left_without_rounds
  FROM _full_card_index_projection;

\echo '== 3b. Affected players (largest movement first) =='
SELECT *
  FROM _full_card_index_projection
 ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(projected_index, 0) - COALESCE(stored_index, 0)) DESC, name;

\echo '== 4. Combined 18s built from an incomplete nine (review; not deleted) =='
SELECT hcr.id                    AS combined_round_id,
       pl.name                   AS player,
       hcr.handicap_differential,
       hcr.effective_date,
       public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(fs.scores, COALESCE(fr.nine_type, 'full')) AS front_complete,
       public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(bs.scores, COALESCE(br.nine_type, 'full')) AS back_complete,
       hcr.front_scorecard_id,
       hcr.back_scorecard_id
  FROM public.handicap_combined_rounds hcr
  JOIN public.players pl ON pl.id = hcr.player_id
  JOIN public.scorecards fs ON fs.id = hcr.front_scorecard_id
  JOIN public.rounds fr ON fr.id = fs.round_id
  JOIN public.scorecards bs ON bs.id = hcr.back_scorecard_id
  JOIN public.rounds br ON br.id = bs.round_id
 WHERE NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(fs.scores, COALESCE(fr.nine_type, 'full'))
    OR NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(bs.scores, COALESCE(br.nine_type, 'full'))
 ORDER BY hcr.effective_date DESC;

\echo '== 5. League rounds tagged from an incomplete card (review; not deleted) =='
SELECT lr.id                     AS league_round_id,
       lg.name                   AS league,
       pl.name                   AS player,
       lr.handicap_differential,
       lr.tagged_at,
       lr.scorecard_id
  FROM public.league_rounds lr
  JOIN public.leagues lg ON lg.id = lr.league_id
  JOIN public.players pl ON pl.id = lr.player_id
  JOIN public.scorecards s ON s.id = lr.scorecard_id
  JOIN public.rounds r ON r.id = s.round_id
 WHERE NOT public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(s.scores, COALESCE(r.nine_type, 'full'))
 ORDER BY lr.tagged_at DESC;

DROP VIEW _full_card_index_projection;
```

### Task A5a-1: Skins hole counts and settlement over the holes played

Hole values are priced on the round's **planned** holes. The settlement buy-in is `calculateTotalPot(type, value, planned) × holesPlayed / planned / participants`. Today a 9-hole game is priced and settled as 18: a $5 per-hole, 2-player game charges a $45 buy-in for a 9-hole pot of $45. Payouts are therefore never zero-sum.

```ts
/**
 * Skins hole counts
 *
 * A skins game prices each hole on the round's PLANNED hole count (18, or 9
 * for a front/back nine) and settles over the holes actually PLAYED. When a
 * round ends early the pot shrinks in proportion to the holes played, so an
 * individual game's settlement stays zero-sum within cent rounding (I11).
 *
 * Pure: the round-row read lives in services/skins/roundHoleCounts.ts.
 */

import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { getHoleCount, HOLES_PER_ROUND } from '@/constants/scoring';

export interface SkinsHoleCounts {
  /** Holes the round was set up for (18 or 9) — prices each hole. */
  plannedHoles: number;
  /** Holes actually played (1..plannedHoles) — sizes the settled pot. */
  holesPlayed: number;
}

/** A full 18 played as planned — the pricing every caller used before hole counts existed. */
export const DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS: SkinsHoleCounts = {
  plannedHoles: HOLES_PER_ROUND,
  holesPlayed: HOLES_PER_ROUND,
};

/**
 * Hole counts for a round row: planned = getHoleCount(nine_type ?? 'full');
 * played = holes_played when it is a count in 1..planned, else planned.
 */
export function getSkinsHoleCounts(
  round: { nine_type?: NineType | null; holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined
): SkinsHoleCounts {
  const plannedHoles = getHoleCount(round?.nine_type ?? 'full');
  const played = round?.holes_played;
  const holesPlayed =
    played != null && played > 0 && played <= plannedHoles ? played : plannedHoles;
  return { plannedHoles, holesPlayed };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The pot actually played for: the planned pot
 * (calculateTotalPot(type, value, plannedHoles)) scaled by holes played /
 * holes planned. Equals the planned pot for a round played as planned.
 */
export function calculatePlayedPot(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value'>,
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts
): number {
  const { plannedHoles, holesPlayed } = holeCounts;
  const plannedPot = calculateTotalPot(game.pot_type, game.pot_value, plannedHoles);
  if (holesPlayed >= plannedHoles) return plannedPot;
  return roundCurrency((plannedPot * holesPlayed) / plannedHoles);
}

/**
 * Each participant's buy-in: the played pot split evenly. For a round played
 * as planned this is exactly calculateBuyIn over the planned holes, so a
 * complete 18-hole game prices as before.
 */
function calculateSettlementBuyIn(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value'>,
  participantCount: number,
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts
): number {
  return roundCurrency(calculatePlayedPot(game, holeCounts) / participantCount);
}

export function calculateFinalPayoutsWithCarryover(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value' | 'participant_ids'>,
  results: Pick<SkinsResult, 'hole_number' | 'winner_id' | 'is_carryover' | 'payout_amount' | 'carryover_to_next' | 'hole_scores'>[],
  participants: PayoutParticipant[],
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
): FinalPayoutResult {
  // The remaining carryover is the HIGHEST hole's (calculateCurrentCarryover).
  // Results after the last played hole don't exist at settlement: the
  // end_round_early RPC deletes them when the round is ended.
  const buyIn = calculateSettlementBuyIn(game, participants.length, holeCounts);
  const payoutMap = accumulateHoleOutcomes(results, participants, buyIn);
```

### Task A5a-2: Price each skins hole on the planned holes

A skins hole is worth `calculateHoleValue(type, value, plannedHoles)`. Today it is always priced over 18, so a 9-hole $90 total pot pays $5 a hole instead of $10.

The per-hole mutations fetch the round's counts themselves (`fetchSkinsHoleCounts(game.round_id)`), so none of their four callers change:
- `useProcessSkinsIfNeeded`;
- `backfillSkinsResults`;
- `teamSkinsProcessor`;

```tsx
/**
 * Per-hole skins pricing: a hole is worth pot / planned holes (9 for a
 * front/back nine), not pot / 18.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { act, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useProcessSkinsHole, useProcessTeamSkinsHole } from '@/hooks/skins/mutations';
import type { SkinsHoleScores, SkinsTeamHoleScores } from '@/types/database/skins.types';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));
jest.mock('@/services/api/players', () => ({ fetchPlayerListByIds: jest.fn() }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/useAuth', () => ({ useAuth: () => ({ user: null }) }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/achievements/useCheckAchievements', () => ({
  useCheckAchievements: () => ({ checkAndAward: jest.fn(), isReady: false }),
}));
jest.mock('@/context/AchievementToastContext', () => ({
  useAchievementToast: () => ({ showMultipleToasts: jest.fn() }),
}));

type QueryResult = { data: unknown; error: unknown };

/**
 * PostgREST stand-in: filters chain; `single` / `maybeSingle` resolve the
 * queued results in order; awaiting the chain itself resolves `awaited`.
 */
function makeTable(opts: { single?: QueryResult[]; maybeSingle?: QueryResult[]; awaited?: QueryResult } = {}) {
  const singles = [...(opts.single ?? [])];
  const maybes = [...(opts.maybeSingle ?? [])];
  const awaited = opts.awaited ?? { data: [], error: null };
  const table: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'order', 'insert', 'update', 'upsert']) {
    table[method] = jest.fn(() => table);
  }
  table.single = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(singles.shift() ?? { data: null, error: null }));
  table.maybeSingle = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(maybes.shift() ?? { data: null, error: null }));
  table.then = jest.fn(
    (onFulfilled: (value: QueryResult) => unknown, onRejected?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
      Promise.resolve(awaited).then(onFulfilled, onRejected)
  );
  return table;
}

function makeWrapper() {
  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { mutations: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={client}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

// total_pot $90, gross, two players
const GAME = {
  id: 'g1',
  round_id: 'r1',
  pot_type: 'total_pot',
  pot_value: 90,
  scoring_type: 'gross',
  participant_ids: ['p1', 'p2'],
  is_team_skins: false,
};

// p1 (3) beats p2 (4) outright → p1 wins, no carryover
const HOLE_SCORES: SkinsHoleScores = {
  p1: { gross: 3, net: 3, strokes_received: 0 },
  p2: { gross: 4, net: 4, strokes_received: 0 },
};

/** Individual path: game `single`, results awaited, round `maybeSingle`,
 *  existing-hole `single` (none), then insert().select().single(). */
function wireIndividual(nineType: string | null) {
  const tables = {
    skins_games: makeTable({ single: [{ data: GAME, error: null }] }),
    skins_results: makeTable({
      awaited: { data: [], error: null },
      single: [
        { data: null, error: null },
        { data: { id: 'res-3', skins_game_id: 'g1' }, error: null },
      ],
    }),
    rounds: makeTable({ maybeSingle: [{ data: { nine_type: nineType }, error: null }] }),
  };
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((name: string) => tables[name as keyof typeof tables]);
  return tables;
}

describe('per-hole skins pricing', () => {

    );

  it('keeps pot / 18 for a full round', async () => {

    expect(tables.skins_results.insert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

  it('prices team skins on the planned holes too', async () => {

      }),
      rounds: makeTable({ maybeSingle: [{ data: { nine_type: 'back9' }, error: null }] }),
    };
    mockFrom.mockImplementation((name: string) => tables[name as keyof typeof tables]);
    // scramble uses team_score: t1 3 beats t2 4
    const teamScores: SkinsTeamHoleScores = {
      t1: { team_score: 3, member_scores: {} },
      t2: { team_score: 4, member_scores: {} },
    };
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProcessTeamSkinsHole(), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.mutateAsync({ skinsGameId: 'g1', holeNumber: 12, teamScores, teamFormat: 'scramble' });

    expect(tables.skins_results.upsert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

      { onConflict: 'skins_game_id,hole_number' }
```

Create `src/services/skins/roundHoleCounts.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The hole counts a round's skins games are priced and settled over, read
 * from the round row. Used by per-hole processing (hole value = pot /
 * planned holes), by settlement (finalizeSkinsGame, finalizeSkinsForSubMatch)
 * and by useSkinsHoleCounts.
 *
 * Part A reads nine_type only; B1b adds holes_played to the select once the
 * column exists.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/services/supabase/client';
import { createError } from '@/services/errors';
import { getSkinsHoleCounts, type SkinsHoleCounts } from '@/utils/skins/holeCounts';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

/**
 * @returns Planned / played hole counts. A round row hidden by RLS (no data,
 *   no error) keeps the 18-hole default; a query error throws so money is
 *   never settled on a guessed hole count.
 */
export async function fetchSkinsHoleCounts(roundId: string): Promise<SkinsHoleCounts> {
  const { data, error } = (await supabase
    .from('rounds')
    .select('nine_type')
    .eq('id', roundId)
    .maybeSingle()) as unknown as {
    data: { nine_type?: NineType | null } | null;
    error: { message: string } | null;
  };

  if (error) {
    throw createError(`Failed to load round for skins pricing: ${error.message}`, 'DATABASE');
  }

  return getSkinsHoleCounts(data);
}
```

### Task A5b-1: Extract skins settlement into a non-hook service

The settlement moves out of `useFinalizeSkinsGame`'s `mutationFn` into `finalizeSkinsGame` (non-hook), so A6a's queued "finalise round" item can settle without React.

```ts
// per_hole $5, two players

/** One $5 skin per hole, won by the listed player, holes numbered from 1. */
function wonHoles(winners: string[]) {
  return winners.map((winner, i) => ({
    hole_number: i + 1,
    winner_id: winner,
    is_carryover: false,
    payout_amount: 5,
    carryover_to_next: 0,

function wire({

  resultsError = null as unknown,

    skins_payouts: makeTable({ awaited: { data: null, error: null } }),
    rounds: makeTable({ maybeSingle: [{ data: { nine_type: nineType }, error: null }] }),
  };
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((name: string) => tables[name as keyof typeof tables]);
  return tables;
}
```

```ts
type QueryResult = { data: unknown; error: unknown };

function makeTable(opts: { maybeSingle?: QueryResult[]; awaited?: QueryResult } = {}) {
  const maybes = [...(opts.maybeSingle ?? [])];
  const awaited = opts.awaited ?? { data: [], error: null };
  const table: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'order', 'limit', 'insert', 'update', 'delete']) {
    table[method] = jest.fn(() => table);
  }
  table.maybeSingle = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(maybes.shift() ?? { data: null, error: null }));
  table.then = jest.fn(
    (onFulfilled: (value: QueryResult) => unknown, onRejected?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
      Promise.resolve(awaited).then(onFulfilled, onRejected)
  );
  return table;
}
```

Create `src/services/skins/finalizeSkinsGame.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Skins game settlement — the non-hook core of useFinalizeSkinsGame.
 *
 * Computes each participant's payout, rewrites skins_payouts and marks the
 * game completed. The buy-in is priced over the round's hole counts
 * (fetchSkinsHoleCounts): a 9-hole round's pot covers 9 holes, and a round
 * ended early settles over the holes played, so individual payouts stay
 * zero-sum within cent rounding (I11).
 *
 * Lives outside React so finalizeSubmittedRound — and the queued "finalise
 * round" sync item it backs — can settle a game without a hook.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/services/supabase/client';
import { fetchPlayerListByIds } from '@/services/api/players';
import { createError } from '@/services/errors';
import { calculateFinalPayoutsWithCarryover } from '@/utils/skins';
import type { SkinsHoleCounts } from '@/utils/skins/holeCounts';
import { fetchActiveSkinsGame } from './activeGame';
import { fetchSkinsHoleCounts } from './roundHoleCounts';
import type { SkinsGame, SkinsResult } from '@/types/database/skins.types';

/**
 * Settle one skins game.
 *
 * @param gameId - Skins game to settle
 * @param holeCounts - Override the hole counts (tests / callers that already
 *   hold them). Omitted ⇒ read from the game's round.
 * @returns The game, now `completed`. Throws on any failure.
 */
export async function finalizeSkinsGame(
  gameId: string,
  holeCounts?: SkinsHoleCounts
): Promise<SkinsGame> {
  const { data: rawGame, error: gameError } = await supabase
    .from('skins_games')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', gameId)
    .single();

  const game = rawGame as unknown as SkinsGame | null;

  if (gameError || !game) {
    throw createError('Skins game not found', 'NOT_FOUND');
  }

  const { data: rawResults, error: resultsError } = await supabase
    .from('skins_results')
    .select('*')
    .eq('skins_game_id', gameId)
    .order('hole_number', { ascending: true });

  if (resultsError) {
    throw createError(`Failed to fetch results: ${resultsError.message}`, 'DATABASE');
  }

  const results = (rawResults ?? []) as unknown as SkinsResult[];

  const participants = await fetchPlayerListByIds(game.participant_ids);
  const counts = holeCounts ?? (await fetchSkinsHoleCounts(game.round_id));

  const payoutResult = calculateFinalPayoutsWithCarryover(game, results, participants, counts);

  await supabase.from('skins_payouts').delete().eq('skins_game_id', gameId);

  const payoutInserts = payoutResult.payouts.map((p) => ({
    skins_game_id: gameId,
    player_id: p.player_id,
    buy_in: p.buy_in,
    total_winnings: p.total_winnings,
    net_result: p.net_result,
    holes_won: p.holes_won,
    holes_tied: p.holes_tied,
    holes_lost: p.holes_lost,
  }));

  if (payoutInserts.length > 0) {
    const { error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from('skins_payouts')
      .insert(payoutInserts as never);

    if (insertError) {
      throw createError(`Failed to insert payouts: ${insertError.message}`, 'DATABASE');
    }
  }

  const { data: updatedGame, error: updateError } = await supabase
    .from('skins_games')
    .update({
      status: 'completed',
      completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    } as never)
    .eq('id', gameId)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (updateError) {
    throw createError(`Failed to update game status: ${updateError.message}`, 'DATABASE');
  }

  return updatedGame as unknown as SkinsGame;
}

export interface FinalizeActiveSkinsResult {
  finalized: boolean;
  /** The settled game (status `completed`) when one was finalised. */
  game?: SkinsGame;
  /** The caught failure, when settlement failed. */
  error?: unknown;
}

/**
 * Settle the round's active skins game, if it has one. Never throws: a
 * failure comes back as `{ finalized: false, error }`.
 */
export async function finalizeActiveSkinsForRound(roundId: string): Promise<FinalizeActiveSkinsResult> {
  try {
    const activeGame = await fetchActiveSkinsGame({ roundId });
    if (!activeGame) {
      return { finalized: false };
    }

    const game = await finalizeSkinsGame(activeGame.id);
    return { finalized: true, game };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[finalizeActiveSkinsForRound] Error finalizing skins:', error);
    return { finalized: false, error };
  }
}
```

```ts
/** What awardSkinsAchievements needs from the React side (useAuth / useCheckAchievements / toasts). */
export interface SkinsAchievementContext {
  playerId: string;
  checkAndAward: (
    eventType: AchievementEventType,
    eventData: AchievementEventData
  ) => Promise<{
    hasNewRewards: boolean;
    newAchievements: AchievementDefinition[];
    newCosmetics: CosmeticDefinition[];
  }>;
  showMultipleToasts: (
    achievements: AchievementDefinition[],
    cosmetics?: (CosmeticDefinition | null)[]
  ) => void;
}

/**
 * Skins achievement events for one player after a game settles. Shared by
 * useFinalizeSkinsGame.onSuccess and the round-submit hook (A6c), which
 * settles through finalizeActiveSkinsForRound and so never runs onSuccess.
 * Non-blocking: failures are logged, never thrown.
 */
export async function awardSkinsAchievements(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'id' | 'pot_value'>,
  { playerId, checkAndAward, showMultipleToasts }: SkinsAchievementContext
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    // Query the player's payout to get holes won data
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- Supabase generated types restriction workaround
    const { data: payout } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('skins_payouts')
      .select('holes_won, holes_tied')
      .eq('skins_game_id', game.id)
      .eq('player_id', playerId)
      .single();

    const holesWon = (payout?.holes_won as number) ?? 0;

    // Count carryover wins: holes the player won where previous hole(s) had carryovers
    // A hole with payout_amount > pot_value indicates accumulated carryovers
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- Supabase generated types restriction workaround
    const { data: carryoverWins } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('skins_results')
      .select('id, payout_amount')
      .eq('skins_game_id', game.id)
      .eq('winner_id', playerId)
      .eq('is_carryover', false)
      .not('payout_amount', 'is', null);

    // Filter to holes where payout exceeded the base hole value (indicating carryovers)
    const baseHoleValue = game.pot_value ?? 0;
    const carryoverHolesWon = (carryoverWins as Array<{ payout_amount: number }> | null)
      ?.filter((r) => r.payout_amount > baseHoleValue).length ?? 0;

    // skins_game_completed
    const r1 = await checkAndAward('skins_game_completed', {
      skins_holes_won: holesWon,
    });
    if (r1.hasNewRewards) showMultipleToasts(r1.newAchievements, r1.newCosmetics);

    // skins_hole_won (with counts)
    if (holesWon > 0) {
      const r2 = await checkAndAward('skins_hole_won', {
        skins_holes_won: holesWon,
        skins_carryover_holes_won: carryoverHolesWon,
      });
      if (r2.hasNewRewards) showMultipleToasts(r2.newAchievements, r2.newCosmetics);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[awardSkinsAchievements] Achievement check failed (non-blocking):', error);
  }
}
```

### Task A5c-1: Skins hole-count hook, summary, indicator and settings card

Shared skins displays get the round's hole counts:
- **Completed** games show what was stored (the `skins_payouts` buy-ins for the pot).
- **In-progress** games price holes on the planned count and the pot on the holes played.
- Components that know their round read the counts themselves through a new `useSkinsHoleCounts(roundId)`, so screens don't thread them.

| Site | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/hooks/skins/queries.ts` | New `useSkinsHoleCounts`, pure `buildSkinsSummary`, and `useSkinsSummary(gameId, holeCounts?)`. `total_pot` = Σ stored buy-ins when settled, else the played pot; `per_hole_value` = planned price |
| `SkinsIndicator` + `SkinsSummaryModal` | Summary and the "x/N holes" progress on the round's counts (was `/18`) |
| `useSkinsGameState` (ViewRound settings card) | Per-hole on planned holes; pot = stored buy-ins when settled, else the played pot. The auto-finalise is unchanged (it settles through `fetchSkinsHoleCounts`) |

```ts
});

});
```

```ts
/**
 * useSkinsGameState — the round-settings skins card. Holes are priced on the
 * planned count, the pot on the holes played; a settled game shows its stored
 * buy-ins. The auto-finalise passes only the game id, so settlement reads the
 * round's hole counts (fetchSkinsHoleCounts) itself.
 */
import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useSkinsGameState } from '@/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundDetailsTab/components/useSkinsGameState';

const mockState = {
  games: [] as Record<string, unknown>[],
  payouts: [] as { buy_in: number; total_winnings: number }[],
  results: [] as unknown[],
};
const mockFinalize = jest.fn();
const mockRefetchPayouts = jest.fn();
const mockUseSkinsHoleCounts = jest.fn();

jest.mock('@/hooks/useSkins', () => ({
  useSkinsGamesByRound: () => ({ data: mockState.games, isLoading: false }),
  useSkinsPayouts: () => ({ data: mockState.payouts, isLoading: false, refetch: mockRefetchPayouts }),
  useSkinsResults: () => ({ data: mockState.results, isLoading: false }),
  useFinalizeSkinsGame: () => ({ mutateAsync: mockFinalize, isPending: false }),
  useSkinsHoleCounts: (...args: unknown[]) => mockUseSkinsHoleCounts(...args),
}));

const baseGame = {
  id: 'g1',
  round_id: 'r1',
  status: 'active',
  pot_type: 'total_pot',
  pot_value: 90,
  scoring_type: 'gross',
  participant_ids: ['p1', 'p2'],
};

describe('useSkinsGameState', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockState.games = [baseGame];
    mockState.payouts = [];
    mockState.results = [];
    mockFinalize.mockResolvedValue({});
    mockUseSkinsHoleCounts.mockReturnValue({ plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 18 });
  });

  it('prices a full round played as planned exactly as before', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'in-progress' }));

    expect(result.current.perHoleValue).toBe(5); // $90 / 18
    expect(result.current.totalPot).toBe(90);
  });

  it("reads the round's hole counts and prices an ended-early front nine", () => {
    mockUseSkinsHoleCounts.mockReturnValue({ plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 6 });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'in-progress' }));

    expect(mockUseSkinsHoleCounts).toHaveBeenCalledWith('r1');
    expect(result.current.perHoleValue).toBe(10); // $90 / 9
    expect(result.current.totalPot).toBe(60); // $90 × 6/9
  });

  it('shows the stored buy-ins as the pot once the game is settled', () => {
    mockState.games = [{ ...baseGame, status: 'completed', pot_type: 'per_hole', pot_value: 5 }];
    mockState.payouts = [
      { buy_in: 22.5, total_winnings: 25 },
      { buy_in: 22.5, total_winnings: 20 },
    ];
    mockUseSkinsHoleCounts.mockReturnValue({ plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 9 });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'completed' }));

    expect(result.current.perHoleValue).toBe(5);
    expect(result.current.totalPot).toBe(45); // 22.5 + 22.5 (computed at 18 it would read $90)
  });

  it('auto-finalises with the game id only (settlement reads the hole counts)', () => {
    mockState.results = [{ hole_number: 1 }];

    renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'completed' }));

    expect(mockFinalize).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockFinalize).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ gameId: 'g1' });
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete skins game summary
 *
 * Combines game, results, and payouts with calculated metrics.
 *
 * @param gameId - Skins game UUID
 * @returns Query result with SkinsGameSummary
 */
export function useSkinsSummary(gameId: string | undefined) {
  const gameQuery = useSkinsGame(gameId);
  const resultsQuery = useSkinsResults(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useSkinsPayouts(gameId);

  // Extract data from dependent queries
  const game = gameQuery.data;

  // Compute summary directly using useMemo - this reacts to changes in dependent data
  const summary = useMemo((): SkinsGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;

    const results = resultsQuery.data ?? [];
    const payouts = payoutsQuery.data ?? [];

    const totalPot = calculateTotalPot(game.pot_type, game.pot_value);
    const perHoleValue = calculateHoleValue(game.pot_type, game.pot_value);
    const currentCarryover = calculateCurrentCarryover(results as SkinsResult[]);
    const holesCompleted = results.length;

    return {
      game: game as SkinsGameWithParticipants,
      results: results as SkinsResultWithWinner[],
      payouts: payouts as SkinsPayoutWithPlayer[],
      current_carryover: currentCarryover,
      holes_completed: holesCompleted,
      total_pot: totalPot,
      per_hole_value: perHoleValue,
    };
  }, [game, resultsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data]);
```

Replace with:

```ts
/**
 * Hole counts a round's skins are priced (planned) and settled (played) on,
 * read through fetchSkinsHoleCounts. The 18-hole default while loading or
 * without a round.
 */
export function useSkinsHoleCounts(roundId: string | undefined): SkinsHoleCounts {
  const { data } = useQuery({
    queryKey: skinsKeys.holeCounts(roundId ?? ''),
    queryFn: () => fetchSkinsHoleCounts(roundId as string),
    enabled: !!roundId,
    staleTime: CACHE_TIMES.SHORT,
    gcTime: GC_TIMES.SHORT,
  });
  return data ?? DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS;
}

/**
 * Build a skins game summary. Each hole is priced on the planned holes; the
 * pot is what was actually staked once the game is settled (sum of the
 * stored buy-ins), otherwise the pot for the holes played.
 */
export function buildSkinsSummary(
  game: SkinsGameWithParticipants | SkinsGameWithTeamParticipants,
  results: SkinsResultWithWinner[] | SkinsResultWithTeamWinner[],
  payouts: SkinsPayoutWithPlayer[],
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
): SkinsGameSummary {
  const settledPot =
    game.status === 'completed' && payouts.length > 0
      ? roundCurrency(payouts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.buy_in, 0))
      : null;

  return {
    game: game as SkinsGameWithParticipants,
    results: results as SkinsResultWithWinner[],
    payouts,
    current_carryover: calculateCurrentCarryover(results as SkinsResult[]),
    holes_completed: results.length,
    total_pot: settledPot ?? calculatePlayedPot(game, holeCounts),
    per_hole_value: calculateHoleValue(game.pot_type, game.pot_value, holeCounts.plannedHoles),
  };
}

/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete skins game summary
 *
 * Combines game, results, and payouts with calculated metrics.
 *
 * @param gameId - Skins game UUID
 * @param holeCounts - Holes planned (prices each hole) and played (sizes the
 *   pot); defaults to a full 18 played as planned
 * @returns Query result with SkinsGameSummary
 */
export function useSkinsSummary(
  gameId: string | undefined,
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
) {
  const gameQuery = useSkinsGame(gameId);
  const resultsQuery = useSkinsResults(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useSkinsPayouts(gameId);

  // Extract data from dependent queries
  const game = gameQuery.data;
  const { plannedHoles, holesPlayed } = holeCounts;

  // Compute summary directly using useMemo - this reacts to changes in dependent data
  const summary = useMemo((): SkinsGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;
    return buildSkinsSummary(game, resultsQuery.data ?? [], payoutsQuery.data ?? [], {
      plannedHoles,
      holesPlayed,
    });
  }, [game, resultsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data, plannedHoles, holesPlayed]);
```

### Task A5c-2: Skins results card on the round's hole counts

```ts
import type { ParticipantTotal, ResultRow } from '../types';

interface UseSkinsResultRowsParams {
  results: SkinsResultWithWinner[];
  potType: SkinsPotType;
  potValue: number;
  /** Holes planned (prices each hole) and played (finds the game's last hole) */
  holeCounts?: SkinsHoleCounts;
  participants?: SkinsParticipant[];
  isTeamSkins: boolean;
  teams?: SkinsTeamParticipant[];
}

export function useSkinsResultRows({
  results,
  potType,
  potValue,
  holeCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS,
  participants,
  isTeamSkins,
  teams,
}: UseSkinsResultRowsParams) {
  const { plannedHoles, holesPlayed } = holeCounts;

  // Each hole is worth the pot spread over the planned holes
  const perHoleValue = useMemo(
    () => calculateHoleValue(potType, potValue, plannedHoles),
    [potType, potValue, plannedHoles]
  );
```

Replace with:

```ts
  // Calculate front 9 and back 9 totals
  const { front9Total, back9Total, unsettledCarryover } = useMemo(() => {
    let front = 0;
    let back = 0;
    let carryover = 0;

    // Sum up payouts by hole range
    results.forEach((r) => {
      if (r.hole_number <= 9) {
        front += r.payout_amount;
      } else {
        back += r.payout_amount;
      }
    });

    // Unsettled carryover: the game's last hole was tied. That is hole 18, or
    // — for a 9-hole round or one ended early — the highest result once every
    // played hole has one.
    const lastResult = results.reduce<SkinsResultWithWinner | null>(
      (last, r) => (!last || r.hole_number > last.hole_number ? r : last),
      null
    );
    if (
      lastResult &&
      lastResult.is_carryover &&
      (lastResult.hole_number === 18 || results.length >= holesPlayed)
    ) {
      carryover = lastResult.carryover_to_next;
    }

    return { front9Total: front, back9Total: back, unsettledCarryover: carryover };
  }, [results, holesPlayed]);
```

### Task A5d-1: Live skins standings on the round's hole counts

`calculateInProgressPayouts` and `SkinsCurrentStandingsCard` take `holeCounts`, so the live standings price the buy-in exactly as the settlement will. Review's `SkinsTabContent` replaces its `totalHoles` prop with `holeCounts`, and its "still in progress" gate and copy use the holes played. An ended-early round with a result on every played hole therefore stops showing live standings.

```ts
/**
 * Calculate the current standing of an ACTIVE skins game.
 *
 * Same accumulation as the final settlement, except the pending carryover
 * is not split — mid-game it is still winnable on the holes ahead, so it
 * is reported separately instead of being banked to anyone.
 *
 * @param game - The skins game configuration
 * @param results - Hole results so far (partial round)
 * @param participants - List of participants
 * @param totalHoles - Holes the round actually plays (9 or 18); prices the buy-in
 * @returns Standing per participant plus the undistributed carryover
 */
export function calculateInProgressPayouts(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value' | 'participant_ids'>,
  results: Pick<SkinsResult, 'hole_number' | 'winner_id' | 'is_carryover' | 'payout_amount' | 'carryover_to_next' | 'hole_scores'>[],
  participants: PayoutParticipant[],
  totalHoles?: number
): InProgressPayoutResult {
  const buyIn = calculateBuyIn(game.pot_type, game.pot_value, participants.length, totalHoles);
  const payoutMap = accumulateHoleOutcomes(results, participants, buyIn);
```

Replace with:

```ts
/**
 * Calculate the current standing of an ACTIVE skins game.
 *
 * Same accumulation as the final settlement, except the pending carryover
 * is not split — mid-game it is still winnable on the holes ahead, so it
 * is reported separately instead of being banked to anyone.
 *
 * @param game - The skins game configuration
 * @param results - Hole results so far (partial round)
 * @param participants - List of participants
 * @param holeCounts - Holes planned and played; prices the buy-in exactly as
 *   the settlement will. Defaults to a full 18 played as planned.
 * @returns Standing per participant plus the undistributed carryover
 */
export function calculateInProgressPayouts(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value' | 'participant_ids'>,
  results: Pick<SkinsResult, 'hole_number' | 'winner_id' | 'is_carryover' | 'payout_amount' | 'carryover_to_next' | 'hole_scores'>[],
  participants: PayoutParticipant[],
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
): InProgressPayoutResult {
  const buyIn = calculateSettlementBuyIn(game, participants.length, holeCounts);
  const payoutMap = accumulateHoleOutcomes(results, participants, buyIn);
```

### Task A5d-2: Skins payouts tabs from stored settlements

ViewRound `PayoutsTab` and Review `PayoutsTabContent` today re-derive every game's payouts at 18 holes. Now:
- a **completed** game shows its stored `skins_payouts`;
- an unsettled game previews the settlement (`calculateFinalPayouts`) on the round's hole counts.

This fixes the drift on an already-settled 9-hole game ($5 per hole, 2 players, Ann wins 5 of 9). Every tab now shows the stored values.

- Modify: `src/utils/skins/payouts.ts` (new `resolveSkinsNetResults` after `calculateInProgressPayouts`; `SkinsPayout` type import)
- Modify: `src/utils/skins/index.ts` payouts export blocks (as A5a-1 leaves them)
- Modify: `src/__tests__/utils/skinsCalculations.test.ts` (import; append a describe)
